## Results of the Moon’s sub-period in the Sun’s major period (6 months)

When the Moon is in the sub-period of the Sun and is placed in a <term>Kendra</term><note>The 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses; considered the powerful "pillars" of a horoscope.</note> or a <term>Trikona</term><note>The 1st, 5th, or 9th houses; the auspicious "triangular" houses of fortune.</note> from the Ascendant, it brings marriage, auspicious ceremonies, and an abundance of wealth and grain. // 23 // There will be an increase in lands and houses, and the prosperity of cattle and vehicles. If the Moon is in its exaltation sign <note>Taurus</note> or its own sign <note>Cancer</note>, it brings happiness from a spouse and the arrival of wealth. // 24 // 

One gains the joy of a son and has an encounter with the King. Through the favor of the Great King, one's desires are fulfilled and happiness is secured. // 25 // 

If the Moon is waning <note>original: 'ksheene'—the Moon is considered less auspicious when it is losing its light</note> or joined with malefic planets, it causes suffering to the spouse and children. There will be disharmony, disputes with common people, and the loss of the servant class. // 26 // Conflict, quarrels with the government, and the depletion of wealth, grain, and cattle will occur. If the Moon is placed in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house, there is a fear of water and mental illness. // 27 // 

Imprisonment, suffering from disease, and displacement from one’s position will follow. Due to a bad placement, there will be mental distress and strife with kinsmen. // 28 // Poverty, poor quality food, and harassment from thieves or the King may occur. One may suffer from urinary disorders <note>original: 'mutrakrichra'</note>, physical decay, and general bodily pain. // 29 //

If the Moon is in the 11th or 9th house from the Major Period Lord <note>the Sun</note>, or in a Kendra joined with auspicious planets, it brings enjoyment, good fortune, and the growth of happiness for the spouse and children. // 30 // One achieves administrative power <note>original: 'rajya'</note>, great comfort, and a permanent position. It brings marriage, initiation into sacred rituals, and the acquisition of fine grains, clothes, and ornaments. // 31 // 

One obtains vehicles, children, and grandchildren, and happiness continues to grow. However, if the Moon is in the 2nd, 8th, or 12th house from the Major Period Lord and lacks strength... // 32 // ...then one will eat at irregular times and wander from country to country. If the Moon is the lord of the 2nd or 7th house, there is a danger of untimely death. To find peace and gain happiness, one should donate a white cow or a buffalo. // 33 //

# Results of the Rahu sub-period in the Sun’s major period (10 months, 24 days)

When Rahu is in the sub-period of the Sun and is placed in a <term>Kendra</term> or <term>Trikona</term> <note>The powerful 1st, 4th, 7th, 10th or auspicious 5th and 9th houses.</note> from the Ascendant: during the first two months, there is a loss of wealth and great fear. // 42 // 

There is fear of thieves, snakes, and wounds, as well as suffering for one's wife and children. After that, happiness is attained if Rahu is joined with benefics or is in an auspicious <term>Navamsha</term> <note>A specific 1/9th division of a sign used for fine-tuning astrological strength.</note>. // 43 // 

It brings health to the body, satisfaction of mind, and the happiness of the King’s favor. This occurs if Rahu is in an <term>Upachaya</term> house <note>The 3rd, 6th, 10th, or 11th houses, which indicate growth and improvement over time.</note> from the Ascendant and is joined with a <term>Yoga-karaka</term> planet <note>A planet that possesses the power to grant success and prosperity.</note>. // 44 // 

If Rahu is in a favorable sign from the Lord of the Major Period, it grants honor from the King and fame. While there is an increase in fortune and the gain of renown, there may still be some suffering for wife and children. // 45 // 

There will be joy from celebrations for a son and auspicious festivals in the home. However, if Rahu is in the 6th, 12th, or 8th house from the Major Period lord, or is lacking in strength: // 46 // 

It brings imprisonment, loss of one's position, and being cast into jail. There is fear of thieves, snakes, and wounds, though there may be growth in family responsibilities. // 47 // 

There is the loss of four-legged livestock and the destruction of houses and fields. One may suffer from diseases such as <term>Gulma</term> <note>An internal abdominal growth or chronic enlargement of the spleen.</note>, <term>Kshaya</term> <note>A wasting disease or consumption.</note>, and ailments like dysentery. // 48 // 

If Rahu is in the 2nd or 7th house, or joined with the lords of those houses, fear of untimely death and all manner of terrors may arise. // 49 // 

One should perform the <term>Durga Japa</term> <note>Recitation of sacred mantras to the Goddess Durga to remove obstacles.</note> and donate a goat. One should give a black cow or a she-buffalo as a gift; then one will undoubtedly attain peace. // 50 //

## Now, the results of the sub-period of Jupiter within the Sun, lasting 9 months and 18 days.

When Jupiter is in the sub-period <term>Bhukti</term><note>A sub-period of a planet within a larger major period (Dasha).</note> of the Sun, and is placed in a quadrant <term>Kendra</term><note>The 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses of a birth chart, considered pillars of strength.</note> or a trine <term>Trikona</term><note>The 1st, 5th, or 9th houses, considered the most auspicious positions.</note> from the Ascendant <term>Lagna</term>, or is in its sign of exaltation or the division of a friendly planet: there will be marriage and an audience with royalty. // 51 //

There will be the gain of wealth, grain, and other assets, the birth of a son, and great happiness. By the grace of the Great King, one’s desired goals and wealth will be attained. // 52 //

One receives honor and affection from learned Brahmins and gains beloved garments and ornaments. Depending on the influence of the lords of Fortune (9th house) and Action (10th house), there may be the attainment of a kingdom <note>In modern terms, a significant promotion or political power.</note> and great celebrations. // 53 //

The yoga <note>A specific planetary combination.</note> for men and vehicles <note>Original: "Nara-vahana," implying being carried in a palanquin or having modern transport.</note> manifests, along with an increase in status and great comfort. If Jupiter is in an auspicious sign relative to the Major Period Lord <note>The Sun.</note>, fortune will increase and bring ease. // 54 //

The person becomes engaged in acts of charity and dharma, finding joy in the worship of deities. There is devotion to the Guru, the fulfillment of mental desires, and the accumulation of meritorious deeds. // 55 //

If Jupiter is placed in the 6th or 8th house from the Major Period Lord, or is in its sign of debilitation or joined with malefic planets: there will be suffering for the wife and children, physical pain, and great fear. // 56 //

It causes the anger of the King and the destruction of cherished belongings. There is a loss of wealth due to sinful roots, a fall from one's position, and mental illness. // 57 //

To remedy this, one should perform the charity of gold and engage in the chanting of preferred mantras <term>Japya</term>. Through the donation of tawny-colored cows, health is restored. // 58 //

## Now, the results of the sub-period of Saturn within the Sun's major period, lasting 11 months and 12 days.

When Saturn is in the sub-period of the Sun, and is placed in a quadrant or a trine from the Ascendant: there will be the destruction of enemies, great happiness, and a slight gain of grain and wealth. // 59 //

Marriage, festivities, and other auspicious works will bring favorable results. If Saturn is in its sign of exaltation, its own sign, or joined with friendly planets: // 60 //

Wealth and prosperity come to the home, along with ceremonies like marriage. There is royal honor, fame, and the arrival of various garments and riches. // 61 //

If Saturn is in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house from the Major Period Lord, or joined with malefic planets: there will be suffering from wind-related diseases <note>Original: "Vata-shula," often referring to gout, colic, or neuralgic pain.</note>, severe illness, fever, and dysentery. // 62 //

One may face imprisonment, loss of work, loss of wealth, and great fear. Sudden quarrels and disputes with kinsmen will occur. // 63 //

At the beginning of the sub-period, there is a loss of friends; in the middle, it is somewhat comfortable; and at the end, it causes distress. Similar results follow if Saturn is in its sign of debilitation. // 64 //

There may be separation from the father or mother, and constant wandering. If Saturn is the lord of the 2nd or 7th house <note>These are the "Maraka" or death-inflicting houses.</note>, there will be a fear of untimely death. // 65 //

## Now, the results of the sub-period of Mercury within the Sun, lasting 10 months and 6 days.

When Mercury is in the sub-period <term>Bhukti</term><note>A secondary planetary cycle nested within a major period.</note> of the Sun, and is placed in its sign of exaltation, its own sign, or in a trine <term>Trikona</term>, or the eleventh house of gains, and is endowed with strength in the divisional charts: // 67 //

There will be the acquisition of a kingdom <note>In a modern context, this implies significant professional promotion or political success</note>, great enthusiasm, and happiness from one's wife and children. By the grace of the Great King, one will receive vehicles, fine clothing, and ornaments. // 68 //

One will visit holy pilgrimage sites, master various arts, and the home will be filled with cattle and wealth. If Mercury is associated with the lords of the 9th or 11th houses, there will be a steady increase in profits. // 69 //

If Mercury resides in the 9th, 5th, or 10th houses, honor is certain to follow. One will be inclined toward performing one's duties and religious works, and will show devotion to the Guru, religion, and the learned Brahmins. // 70 //

One will be endowed with wealth and grain; there may be a marriage or the birth of a son. If Mercury is placed in an auspicious sign relative to the Major Period Lord <note>The Sun</note>, this sub-period brings great happiness. // 71 //

There will be wedding celebrations, sacrificial rituals, acts of charity, and the chanting of prayers. One may even receive poems written in their honor or gain great fame. // 72 //

With the acquisition of fine food, clothes, and ornaments, the person becomes like the Lord of the Immortals <note>original: "amareśo"; a reference to Indra, suggesting a state of peak worldly power and luxury</note>. However, if Mercury is placed in the 6th, 8th, or 12th houses from the Major Period Lord, or is in its sign of debilitation: // 73 //

There will be physical suffering, mental distress, and troubles involving one's wife and children. At the beginning of the sub-period, one experiences sorrow, though the middle part may bring some comfort. // 74 //

At the end of the period, there is fear of the government <note>original: "rāja-bhīti"; fear of the king or ruling authorities</note> and much restless wandering. If Mercury is the lord of the 2nd or 7th houses, there will be physical illness such as fever. To remedy this, one should recite the *Thousand Names of Vishnu* <note>original: "Viṣṇu-sahasranāma"</note>, distribute food in charity, and donate a silver idol to ensure health. // 75 //

## Now, the results of the sub-period of Ketu within the Sun, lasting 4 months and 6 days.

When Ketu is in the sub-period of the Sun, there will be physical pain, mental agony, loss of wealth, anger from the authorities, and harassment from one's own kinsmen. // 76 //

If Ketu is joined with the Lord of the Ascendant <term>Lagna-adhipati</term>, there is happiness and the arrival of wealth at the beginning; however, in the middle, one experiences distress and may receive news of a death. // 77 //

If Ketu is in the 6th, 8th, or 12th houses from the Major Period Lord, or is joined with malefic planets, there may be diseases of the cheeks or teeth, and the possibility of urinary difficulties. // 78 //

There will be displacement from one's position, loss of wealth, loss of friends, and the death of the father. One may travel to foreign lands and face harassment from enemies and great fear. // 79 //

If Ketu causes trouble relative to the Ascendant, but is joined with a planet that produces success <term>Yoga-karaka</term><note>A planet that owns both a corner and a center house, making it exceptionally auspicious</note>, or is in an auspicious division...

### Results of the Sub-period of Venus in the Major Period of the Sun (Duration: 12 Months)

When Venus is in the sub-period <term>Bhukti</term> of the Sun, and is placed in a trine, in the same house as the Moon, in its sign of exaltation, in a friend's sign, or in its own divisional chart: there will be the enjoyment of wealth and the company of a desired wife. // 84 //

If Venus is placed in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses from the major period lord, or is devoid of strength: there will be the wrath of the government, mental distress, and the loss of children, wife, and wealth. // 88 // 

At the beginning of the sub-period, there may be the gain of a vehicle; in the middle, the gains are auspicious. However, at the end, there is the destruction of fame or even displacement from one's position. // 89 // 

There will be endless hatred from kinsmen and a loss of the comforts provided by one's own clan. If Venus <note>original: "Bhargava"</note> is the lord of the second or seventh house, there will be physical illness and mental affliction. // 90 // 

If associated with the eighth or twelfth houses, there will be (the risk of) untimely death. To remove these faults, one should perform the *Mrityunjaya* prayer. // 91 // One should donate a white cow or a buffalo and perform offerings to the learned Brahmins. // 92 //

### Results of the Sub-period of Mars in the Major Period of the Moon (Duration: 7 Months)

When Mars is in the sub-period of the Moon and is placed in an angle or a trine <note>The 1st, 4th, 7th, 10th or 5th, 9th houses</note> from the Ascendant: there will be good fortune, royal honors, and the acquisition of clothes and ornaments. // 7 // Success in planned efforts and goals will surely occur, without doubt. There will be an increase in houses and lands, and victory in legal or business dealings. // 8 // One finds profit in work and great happiness if Mars is in its sign of exaltation or its own house. However, if Mars is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house, or is joined with a malefic planet: // 9 // or is in an inauspicious position from the major period lord <note>original: "dayesha", the lord of the dasha</note>, one will see bodily pain and loss of status. There will be loss of houses, lands, and the like, and similarly in business dealings. // 10 // There will be quarrels among the servants, opposition from the king <note>In modern terms, the government or employer</note>, separation from one’s own kinsmen, and the constant hearing of harsh speech. // 11 // If the lord of the second or seventh house is in the eighth, or when the lord of the eighth house is involved: to remove these faults, one should perform the worship of a Brahmin. // 12 //

### Results of the Sub-period of Rahu (Duration: 18 Months)

When Rahu is in the sub-period of the Moon and is placed in an angle or a trine from the Ascendant: at first, the results are meager, and there is trouble from enemies and great fear. // 13 // There is fear of thieves, snakes, and the king, as well as suffering involving four-legged animals. One experiences the loss of kin, loss of friends, loss of reputation, and mental agony. // 14 // If Rahu is joined with or aspected by benefics, or is in an "Upachaya" <note>Houses of growth: 3, 6, 10, or 11</note> from the Ascendant, or is related to a planet that causes a "Yoga" <term>Yoga-karaka</term>, then it brings success in efforts and goals. // 15 // From the Southwest or Western direction, there will be a meeting with some powerful lord. One will gain vehicles and clothing, and the realization of desired goals. // 16 // If Rahu is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the major period lord, or is devoid of strength: there will be displacement, mental sorrow, trouble for one’s sons, and great fear. // 17 // There will be difficulties in royal business, suffering for the wife, and great danger. There will be fear of poison from scorpions and such, as well as harassment from thieves, snakes, and the king. // 18 // If placed in an angle, a trine, or the third house from the major period lord...

# Now, the Results of the Sub-period of Jupiter (16 Months)

If Jupiter is in the sub-period of the Moon and is located in an angle or a trine <note>The 1st, 4th, 7th, 10th or 5th, 9th houses from the Ascendant</note> from the Ascendant; or if it is in its own house, the house of gains, or its sign of exaltation: there will be the acquisition of a kingdom and great festivities. // 22 // One will obtain clothes, jewelry, and ornaments, royal favor, and the arrival of wealth. By the grace of one’s <term>Ishta-devata</term> <note>A personal or beloved deity chosen for worship</note>, there will be results such as the conception of a child. // 23 // Auspicious and celebratory works will take place, and the goddess Lakshmi <note>The goddess of wealth and prosperity</note> will cast a favorable glance upon the home. There will be royal patronage, wealth, and the acquisition of lands, elephants, and horses. // 24 // Through the favor of a great king, one's desires will be fulfilled, leading to happiness. If Jupiter is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house, or is in its sign of debilitation, or is combust <note>Too close to the Sun, losing its power</note>: // 25 // or is joined with a malefic planet, there will be inauspicious deeds, the loss of teachers or sons, displacement from one’s position, mental grief, and certain sudden quarrels. // 26 // There will be the destruction of the home and fields, and the loss of vehicles and clothing. If Jupiter is in an angle or trine from the Lord of the Major Period <note>The Moon</note>, or in the third or eleventh house: // 27 // it brings great enthusiasm, fine food, clothing, and cattle. There will be happiness from brothers and others, wealth, courage, strength, and valor. // 28 // There will be the performance of sacrifices, displays of power, marriage, royal splendor, wealth, and prosperity. If Jupiter is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the Lord of the Major Period, or is devoid of strength: // 29 // it brings poor quality food and travel to foreign lands. It is said that the beginning of the sub-period is auspicious, but the end will be troublesome. // 30 // If the planet is the lord of the second or seventh house, there will be fear of untimely death. To remedy this defect, one should chant the <term>Shiva Sahasranama</term> <note>The Thousand Names of Lord Shiva</note>. The donation of gold is also prescribed, as it bestows all kinds of prosperity. // 31 //

There will be the birth of a son, general well-being, and the majesty of royal favor. // 34 // If Saturn is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house, or in its sign of debilitation, or in the house of wealth... in that sub-period...

# Now, the Results of the Sub-period of Mercury (17 Months)

During the sub-period of Mercury <note>original: 'Saumya'</note> in the major period of the Moon, if Mercury is in an angle, the house of gains, or a trine; or if it is in its own sign, its <term>Navamsha</term> <note>A 1/9th divisional chart used for fine-tuning predictions</note>, or its sign of exaltation, and is endowed with strength: // 39 // There will be the arrival of wealth, royal honor, and the gain of favorite clothes. There will be acquisition of pearls, jewels, corals, vehicles, clothes, and ornaments. // 43 // Health, affection, and happiness will prevail, along with the joy of ritual drinks <note>original: 'Somapana', referring to the ritual consumption of Soma</note>.

If Mercury is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses <note>These are the 'Dusthanas' or houses of suffering</note> from the lord of the major period, or in its sign of debilitation: // 44 // That sub-period brings bodily distress and the destruction of crops, cattle, and land. It may lead to entering prison and suffering for one's wife and children. // 45 // If Mercury is the lord of the second or seventh house, there will be suffering from fever and great fear. One should perform the donation of a goat and chant the <term>Vishnu Sahasranama</term> <note>The Thousand Names of Lord Vishnu</note>. // 46 //

### Now, the Results of the Sub-period of Mars (within the Major Period of Mars): 4 Months, 27 Days

When the sub-period is Mars <note>original: 'Bhauma'</note> during the major period of Mars, if it is placed in an angle, a trine <note>original: 'kendra-trikoṇa'; the 1st, 4th, 7th, 10th or 1st, 5th, 9th houses</note>, the house of gains <note>11th house</note>, the house of wealth <note>2nd house</note>, or the house of courage <note>3rd house</note>: // 1 //

There will be distress from thieves, snakes, and kings, as well as the loss of wealth, grain, and cattle. If it is the lord of the second or seventh houses, there will be physical illness and mental distress. // 6 //

This brings about health and bestows all forms of prosperity. // 8 //

### The Results of the Sub-period of Ketu (Duration: 4 months, 27 days)

When Ketu is in the sub-period of Mars, if it is placed in a trine <note>1st, 5th, or 9th house</note>, an angle <note>1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th house</note>, the third house, or the house of gains <note>11th house</note>, or if it is joined with or aspected by beneficial planets: // 48 //

There will be the favor of the king, peace, much happiness, and the arrival of wealth. At the beginning of the period, there are results such as the acquisition of land and the birth of a son. // 49 //

Success in royal affairs and the gain of four-legged animals <note>livestock or transport animals</note> will occur. If Ketu is placed in a "Yoga-forming" position <note>a planet that confers power and success</note> and is endowed with strength and vitality: // 50 //

The birth of a son, an increase in fame, and the grace of Lakshmi in the home will follow. One will gain wealth from servants and subordinates, achieve the rank of a general, and experience great happiness. // 51 //

It makes the person a friend of the ruler and brings opportunities for sacred sacrifices <note>original: 'yaga'</note>, fine clothing, and ornaments. 

If Ketu is placed in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses from the lord of the major period, or is joined with malefic planets: // 52 //

There will be quarrels, dental diseases, and affliction from thieves and tigers <note>historically representing predators or dangerous enemies</note>. Fever, dysentery, skin diseases <note>original: 'kushtha'</note>, and distress to one's wife and children will occur. // 53 //

If Ketu is in the second or seventh house, disease will manifest in the body. There will be a loss of honor, distress caused by people, and a falling away of wealth and grain. // 54 //

### The Results of the Sub-period of Venus (Duration: 14 months)

When Venus is in the sub-period of Mars, if it is in an angle, the house of gains, or a trine; or if it is in its sign of exaltation <note>where it is strongest</note>, its own sign, or is the lord of an auspicious house: // 55 //

There will be the gain of a kingdom <note>political power or high status</note>, great happiness, and the acquisition of elephants, horses, garments, and ornaments. If Venus is connected to the lord of the ascendant <note>the planet ruling the first house</note>, there will be an increase in children and wife. // 56 //

An increase in lifespan, lordship, prosperity, and the happiness of rising fortune will occur. If it is located in an angle or the house of gains from the lord of the major period...

### The Results of the Sub-period of the Sun (Duration: 4 months, 6 days)

When the Sun <note>original: 'Surya'</note> is in the sub-period of Mars, and is placed in its sign of exaltation, its own sign, or in an angle <note>1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th house</note>; // 64 //

Or if it is in its 'moolatrikona' <note>primary root sign</note>, the eleventh house, or associated with the lords of the ninth or tenth houses: in that sub-period, one attains vehicles, fame, and the birth of a son. There will be an abundance of wealth and grain, and auspicious celebrations <note>original: 'kalyana'</note> will take place in the home. // 65 //

One enjoys safety, health, great courage, and happiness, being honored by the king. Business ventures will yield high profits, and one may have an audience with a king in a foreign land. // 66 //

However, if the Sun is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the lord of the major period, or is joined with malefic planets: there will be bodily pain, mental agony, failure in one's work, and great fear. // 67 //

Diseases of the head, fevers, or even dysentery may occur. If the Sun is the lord of the second or seventh house, there is fear of snakes, fever, and poison. // 68 //

This also brings suffering to children. One should perform the prescribed peace rituals <note>original: 'shanti'</note>. This will restore health to the body and provide an abundance of wealth and grain. // 69 //

### Now, the Sub-period of Rahu within Rahu: 32 months and 12 days. Its results.

If Rahu is placed in the signs of Cancer <note>original: 'Kulira'</note>, Scorpio, Virgo, or Sagittarius: during its sub-period, there is royal honor, and the acquisition of clothes, vehicles, and ornaments. // 1 // 

There is an increase in profit from business and gains from four-legged animals. Travel toward the western direction will bring the acquisition of vehicles and garments. // 2 //

If Rahu is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house, or joined with or aspected by malefic planets: there will be pain from thieves and wounds, and harassment from people everywhere. // 5 // 

Enmity with people at the royal court and the destruction of dear relatives. Suffering for wife and children, and harassment from people everywhere. // 6 // 

If the sub-period lord rules the second or seventh house, or occupies the seventh house: there will always be disease and great distress. One should perform pacification rituals <term>Shanti (remedial ceremonies to balance planetary influences)</term> according to the prescribed rules. Health and wealth will then surely follow; of this, there is no doubt. // 7 //

### Results of the Sun’s Sub-period: 10 months and 22 days

When the Sun is in the sub-period of Rahu, and is placed in its sign of exaltation, its own sign, or in an angle <term>Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses)</term>, a trine <term>Trikona (1st, 5th, or 9th houses)</term>, or the house of gain... or if it is in its exaltation or own division in the birth chart... // 60 //

...and is aspected by benefic planets, it brings favor from the king and general auspiciousness. There will be an abundance of wealth and grain, and even a small amount of happiness will be deeply comforting. // 61 //

There will be lordship over a small village and modest profits. If the Sun is joined with the lords of the ninth or first houses, or is aspected by the lord of the tenth house... // 62 //

...one gains royal patronage, great fame, and significant travel to foreign lands. This combination brings the possibility of ruling a territory and the acquisition of elephants, horses, fine clothing, and jewelry. // 63 //

One's heart's desires will be fulfilled, and there will be auspicious events regarding one's sons. However, if the Sun is placed in the twelfth, eighth, or sixth house from the major period lord (Rahu), or is in its sign of debilitation... // 64 //

...then fever, dysentery, quarrels, and the displeasure of the king will occur. There will be frequent travel, an increase in enemies, and suffering caused by the king, thieves, or fire. // 65 //

If the Sun is in an angle, a trine, the third house, or the house of gain relative to the major period lord, it brings royal honors in foreign lands and auspicious welfare. // 66 //

However, if the Sun is the lord of the second or seventh house, a great illness will occur. One should perform the prescribed peace-making rituals <term>Shanti</term> for the Sun to ensure the recovery of health. // 67 //

### Results of the Moon’s Sub-period: 18 months

In the sub-period of the Moon during the major period of Rahu, if the Moon is in its own sign, its sign of exaltation, or placed in an angle, a trine, or the house of gain... or even if it is in a friend's sign though joined with a malefic... // 68 //

...it results in leadership, being honored by the king, and the acquisition of wealth and assets. There will be health, the gain of ornaments, and prosperity involving friends, wives, sons, and general riches. // 69 //

If it is a Full Moon, the results are fully realized, bringing auspiciousness through royal favor. There will be the gain of horses and vehicles, as well as houses and lands...

# Results of the Sub-period of Mars: 12 months and 18 days

When Mars <term>Bhauma / Kuja</term> is in the sub-period of Rahu, and is placed in the house of gain <term>Labha (11th house)</term> or a trine <term>Trikona (5th or 9th houses)</term> from the ascendant <term>Lagna</term>, or in an angle, or is associated with beneficial planets, or is in its sign of exaltation or its own sign... // 76 //

By the grace of one's chosen deity <term>Ishta-devata</term>, there will be happiness from children and good food. // 77 // Great happiness will come through the quick availability of enjoyments, as well as the acquisition of ornaments and clothing. If Mars is in an angle, a trine, the third house <term>Dushchikya</term>, or the house of gain from the major period lord... // 78 //

...one will obtain red garments and the like, undertake travels, and have an audience with the king <note>government authorities</note>. There will be auspicious events among one’s children and great happiness from one’s employer. // 79 // One may gain a position of command <term>Senapatyam (leadership or military rank)</term>, experience great enthusiasm, and gain wealth through brothers. But if Mars is in the eighth, twelfth, or sixth house from the major period lord and is associated with malefic planets... // 80 //

...there will be loss of wife and children, and suffering for one's brothers. One may suffer displacement from one's position and experience conflict with relatives, wife, and children. // 81 // There will be fear from thieves, snakes, and wounds, and brothers will face distress. While the beginning of the period may be troublesome, one will find happiness in the middle and at the end. // 82 // If Mars is the lord of the second or seventh house, there will be physical lethargy and great fear. To remedy this, one should give a bull and a cow in charity, and health will return. // 83 //

# Chapter 41: Results of the Sub-periods of Jupiter in the Vimshottari System

## Results of the Sub-period of Jupiter: 25 months and 18 days.

If Jupiter is located in its sign of exaltation <term>Ucha (where a planet is at its maximum strength)</term>, its own sign <term>Sva-kshetra</term>, or in an angle <term>Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses)</term> or a trine <term>Trikona (1st, 5th, or 9th houses)</term> from the ascendant <term>Lagna</term>: // 1 //

The person will become a leader of many kings, wealthy, and honored by royalty. There will be gains of cattle and buffaloes, fine clothes, vehicles, and jewelry. // 2 // They will undertake the construction of new residences, complete with grand mansions and surrounding walls. This period brings the wealth of elephants <note>symbolizing immense status and power</note>, prosperity, fortune, and professional success. One receives honors from learned Brahmins and the ruling class, and meets with influential peers. // 3 //

One gains more results from their own superiors and receives the joy of a wife and children. 

However, if Jupiter is in its sign of debilitation <term>Nicha (where a planet is weakest)</term> or located in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses <note>known as the 'dusthana' or difficult houses</note>: // 4 //

There will be association with low-born individuals, great sorrow, and hostility from kinsmen. There will be quarrels, lack of discernment, and the threat of an untimely death <term>Apamrityu</term> among one's superiors. // 5 // Separation from wife and children occurs, along with the loss of wealth, grains, and property. Due to the malefic influence of the lord of the seventh house <note>a 'maraka' or death-inflicting house</note>, there will be physical ailments. // 6 //

To remove these ill effects, one should recite the Thousand Names of Shiva <note>Shiva Sahasranama</note>, perform the Rudra-chanting <term>Rudra Japa</term>, and donate a cow. By doing so, one’s desires will be fulfilled. // 7 //

## Results of the Sub-period of Saturn: 30 months and 12 days.

When Saturn <term>Shani</term> is in the sub-period of Jupiter, and if Saturn is in its sign of exaltation, its own sign, or a friend’s sign, and is positioned in an angle, a trine, or the house of gain <term>Labha (11th house)</term> from the ascendant while endowed with strength: // 8 //

There will be the acquisition of territory, great happiness, and the possession of clothes and ornaments. It brings an abundance of wealth and grains, and the joy of finding a wife and much comfort. // 9 // Gains of vehicles, garments, and livestock will occur, along with improvements in status. The person enjoys the happiness of children and friends and the prestige of being carried in a litter <term>Nara-vahana (palanquin)</term>. // 10 //

One will acquire blue garments and obtain a blue-black horse. Traveling toward the West, the person will meet with royalty. // 11 // Various types of vehicles will be gained during this sub-period of Saturn. 

But if Saturn is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the ascendant, or is debilitated, combust <note>too close to the sun</note>, or in an enemy's sign: // 12 //

There will be destruction of wealth and grains, suffering from fevers, and mental distress. Afflictions will fall upon the wife and children, or physical ailments like ulcers and wounds may arise. // 13 // Inauspicious events will occur at home, and there will be suffering among servants and staff. Loss of cattle and buffaloes and enmity with relatives will follow. // 14 //

If Saturn is in an angle or trine from the major period lord <note>Jupiter</note>, or in the house of gain or wealth: gain of land, wealth, and the birth of a son will bring happiness. // 15 // Gains of cattle and buffaloes—

## Results of the Sub-period of Mercury: 2 years, 3 months, 6 days.

If Mercury <term>Saumya</term> is located in an angle <term>Kendra</term>, a trine <term>Trikona</term>, or the eleventh house <note>the house of gains</note> from the ascendant, or if it is in its sign of exaltation, its own sign, or joined with the ruler of the major period: // 20 //

There will be the acquisition of wealth, physical well-being, gain of status or "kingdom," and great happiness. By the favor of high authorities <note>literally "the great King"</note>, one’s desires will be fulfilled, bringing comfort. // 21 // The home will be filled with vehicles, fine clothing, animals, cattle, and wealth. Results from one’s professional efforts will not be favorable, and one may suffer from fever or dysentery. If Mercury is the ruler of the sign of exaltation or is placed in the ninth house <note>the house of fortune</note> or an angle from the major period ruler: // 23 //

There will be gain of wealth in one's own country and happiness for one's father and mother. One will possess elephants and horses <note>symbols of high status and transport</note> and receive the favor of friends in high places. // 24 // If Mercury is placed in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the ruler of the major period, or is joined with malefic planets and lacks the aspect of beneficial planets, there will be a loss of wealth and grain. // 25 //

This will lead to travel in foreign lands, fear of thieves while traveling, skin ulcers, inflammation, eye diseases, and displacement from various regions. // 26 // If Mercury is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the ascendant <term>Lagna</term> or joined with malefic planets, sudden quarrels will arise and harsh speech will be heard within the home. // 27 //

There will be a loss of four-legged animals <note>livestock</note> and legal disputes. There is fear of untimely death and conflict with enemies. // 28 // If Mercury is joined with or aspected by beneficial planets, there will be happiness from one's spouse and the arrival of wealth. In the beginning of the period, there is auspiciousness, physical health, and gains of vehicles and clothes. // 29 //

At the end of the period, however, there may be loss of wealth, though personal happiness remains. If Mercury is the ruler of the second or seventh house, there is danger of untimely death. // 30 // To remedy these defects, one should chant the *Thousand Names of Vishnu*. One should perform charities and peace-making rituals <term>Shanti</term> to please Mercury; this will increase longevity and bring all forms of good fortune and prosperity. // 31 //

# Section One: Chapter 41 – Results of the Sub-periods of Jupiter in the Vimshottari System

## The Sub-period of Ketu: 11 Months and 6 Days.

During the sub-period <term>Antardasha</term> of Ketu within the major period of Jupiter <term>Jiva</term>, if Ketu is associated with beneficial planets: one obtains various comforts and wealth, yet may consume food that is considered low-quality or base <note>original: "kutshita-annasya," referring to food that is ritually or nutritionally inferior</note>. // 32 //

One may eat the food of others or food provided at funeral rites <note>original: "shraddha-annam"</note>, and wealth may be acquired through sinful means. If Ketu is positioned in the second, eighth, or twelfth house <note>the 'dusthanas' or houses of loss and difficulty</note> from the ruler of the major period, or is joined with malefic planets: // 33 //

One faces the displeasure of the government <note>literally "the King's anger"</note>, loss of wealth, imprisonment, and suffering from disease. There will be a decline in physical strength, hatred toward the father and brothers, and mental distress. // 34 //

If Ketu is located in the fifth, ninth, fourth, or tenth house from the ruler of the major period: one gains vehicles <note>literally "man-carried vehicles" like palanquins</note>, elephants, horses, and fine clothing. // 35 //

By the favor of a great King, one’s desired works and profits are realized. There is an increase in the fruits of one's professional efforts and the acquisition of cattle and buffaloes. // 36 //

Wealth may come through a foreign ruler <term>Yavana</term> or through the father’s garments and assets. However, if Ketu is the ruler of the second or seventh house <note>the 'maraka' or death-inflicting houses</note>, physical suffering will occur. // 37 //

To remedy this, one should gift a goat and perform the recitation of the *Conqueror of Death* mantra <term>Mrityunjaya Japa</term>. One should perform the prescribed peace rituals <term>Shanti</term> to pacify all afflictions according to tradition. // 38 //

## The Sub-period of Venus: 32 Months.

During the sub-period of Venus <term>Shukra</term> within the major period of Jupiter, if Venus is joined with the rulers of the ninth <note>fortune</note> or angular houses <term>Kendra</term>, or is placed in the eleventh or fifth house, or resides in its own sign accompanied by benefics: // 39 //

One gains vehicles, elephants, horses, and fine clothing. By the grace of a great King, one gains more land and experiences great happiness. There will be the acquisition of blue garments and weapons. // 40 //

Journeys toward the East will result in the acquisition of wealth. There will be auspicious events, great affection, and happiness derived from one's mother and father. // 41 //

One will feel devotion toward the gods and the Guru and perform great acts of charity through the distribution of food. By constructing ponds and temple gateways <term>Gopuras</term>, one will accumulate vast spiritual merit. // 42 //

If Venus is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the ruler of the major period, or is in its sign of debilitation: there will be quarrels, discord with relatives, and suffering for one's wife and children. // 43 //

If Venus is joined with Saturn <term>Manda</term> or Rahu: there will be disputes, conflict with the King, and quarrels involving women or the father-in-law. // 44 //

There may be disputes with one's own brother and a loss of wealth and grain. However, if Venus is located in an angular house, the second house, or the ninth house from the ruler of the major period: // 45 //

There will be a gain of wealth and grain, the gain of a wife, and an audience with the King. // 46 //

One will obtain vehicles, the birth of children, and great success in the growth of livestock...

# The Results of the Sub-period of the Sun: 9 Months and 18 Days.

During the sub-period <term>Antardasha</term> of the Sun <term>Surya</term> within the major period of Jupiter <term>Jiva</term>, if the Sun is in its sign of exaltation <note>Aries</note> or in its own sign <note>Leo</note>: // 51 // 

Or if it is placed in a quadrant <term>Kendra</term>, a trine <term>Trikona</term>, the third house <term>Duschikya</term>, or the eleventh house <term>Labha</term>; or in the ninth house <term>Bhagya</term>, endowed with strength, or similarly placed from the ruler of the major period: At that time, there will be gain of wealth and honor and prosperity from the government. // 52 // 

The acquisition of vehicles, clothing, cattle, and ornaments occurs, as well as the birth of a son. Through the grace of friends and superiors, one's desires are fulfilled, and success is auspicious in all undertakings. // 53 // 

If the Sun is positioned in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the ruler of the major period: there will be suffering from head-related diseases and fever. // 54 // 

One faces a lack of virtuous actions and the performance of sinful deeds. There will be hatred from all people and separation from one's own kinsmen. // 55 // 

Sudden quarrels occur during the Sun’s sub-period within Jupiter. If the Sun is the lord of the second or seventh house, physical suffering will manifest. // 56 // 

To remedy these defects, one should recite the *Aditya Hridayam* <note>original: "Aditya-hridayam," a sacred hymn to the Sun-god found in the Ramayana</note>. To pacify all suffering, one should perform acts to please the Sun. // 57 //

# The Results of the Sub-period of the Moon: 16 Months.

During the sub-period of the Moon <term>Chandra</term> within Jupiter, if the Moon is in a quadrant, the eleventh house, or a trine; or in its exaltation or its own sign, and endowed with the strength of the full Moon: // 58 // 

Or if it is in an auspicious sign relative to the ruler of the major period: one receives honor from the government and prosperity. There is happiness from wife and children, and the enjoyment of fine dairy foods <note>original: "kshiranaam bhojanam," literally milk-based food, a symbol of luxury</note>. // 59 // 

Virtuous deeds are performed, fame increases, and there is growth among sons and grandsons. By the favor of a great King, one finds total happiness and the arrival of wealth. // 60 // 

One finds happiness from many people and the accumulation of merit through charity and dharma. If the Moon is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house, or in a trine joined with malefic planets: // 61 // 

Or if it is in the sixth, eighth <term>Randhra</term>, or twelfth house from the ruler of the major period, or is devoid of strength: there will be loss of honor, wealth, and kinsmen, and travel to foreign lands...

->॥ 76 ॥<- One will certainly be troubled by a heavy load of household duties. There will be conflict with one's brother and distress caused by the wife and other family members. ->॥ 77 ॥<- Inauspicious events will occur at home, along with the certainty of fear from bad dreams. Sudden quarrels will arise, and diseases may be caused by minor spirits or "void" energies <term>kshudra-shunya</term> <note>original: "kshudrashunyadi-rogakrit"; this refers to traditional beliefs in ailments caused by low-level supernatural forces or spiritual emptiness</note>. ->॥ 78 ॥<- If Rahu is positioned in the second or seventh house <note>known as "killer" or Maraka houses in astrology</note>, one should predict physical suffering. To remove these afflictions, one should perform the <term>Mrityunjaya-japa</term> <note>a sacred chant dedicated to Lord Shiva, the "Conqueror of Death," used for health and longevity</note>. ->॥ 79 ॥<- One should perform the charity of a goat <note>a traditional ritual remedy to appease Rahu</note>; this will lead to all forms of happiness. ->॥ 80 ॥<-

Thus ends the forty-first chapter, titled "The Results of the Sub-periods within the Major Period of Jupiter," in the First Section of the Summary of the Great Parashara Hora. ॥ 41 ॥

# Now, the Results of the Sub-period of Saturn within the Major Period of Saturn: 36 Months 
## and 0 Days.

If Saturn is in its <term>Moolatrikona</term> <note>an especially powerful and favorable zodiacal position</note>, in its own sign, or in Libra (its sign of exaltation), or if it is in a quadrant, a trine, or the house of gains <note>the 1st, 4th, 7th, 10th, 3rd, 5th, or 11th houses</note>, and is associated with combinations for royal power <term>Rajayoga</term>: ॥ 1 ॥ The person gains a kingdom, great happiness, and the prosperity of wife and children. They will possess three types of vehicles <note>traditionally implying palanquins, horses, and elephants</note> and an abundance of elephants, horses, and fine clothing. ॥ 2 ॥ Through the favor of the great king <note>the government or high authorities</note>, one will gain through horse-related duties or as an envoy, and will acquire four-legged animals, villages, and land. ॥ 3 ॥ If Saturn is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house, or in its sign of debilitation, or joined with malefic planets: At the beginning of the sub-period, there is royal favor, but later, suffering from poison or weapons. ॥ 4 ॥ There will be bleeding, abdominal tumors <term>gulma</term>, diarrhea, and similar afflictions. In the middle of the period, there is fear of thieves, leaving one's country, and mental anguish. ॥ 5 ॥ At the end, it becomes auspicious, bringing the gain of villages and land. However, if Saturn is the lord of the second or seventh house, an untimely death <term>apamrityu</term> may occur. ॥ 6 ॥ To remove these afflictions, one should perform the <term>Mrityunjaya-japa</term>. ॥ 7 ॥

There is success in ritual sacrifices <term>Yajna</term> and the potential for royal status. ॥ 9 ॥ There will be physical health, enthusiasm in the heart, and auspicious events like marriages in the home. One attains the fruits of bathing at the <term>Setu</term> <note>The sacred bridge at Rameswaram; a pilgrimage believed to grant high merit</note>...

### Now, the Results of the Sub-period of Ketu: 13 Months and 9 Days.

If Ketu is within the sub-period of Saturn <term>Manda</term> and is associated with or aspected by beneficial planets, or is in its sign of exaltation, an auspicious sign, or joined with planets that cause success <term>yoga-karaka</term>: ॥ 16 ॥ <note>The text here contrasts the positive placement with the negative results that often follow Ketu's influence.</note> During the sub-period of Ketu within Saturn, there may be displacement from one's position, great fear, the threat of imprisonment due to poverty, and the loss of sons and wife. ॥ 17 ॥ One's employer or master may face great distress, and there may be travel to foreign lands. However, if Ketu is joined with the lord of the Ascendant, there will be happiness and the arrival of wealth at the beginning of the period. ॥ 18 ॥ One will bathe in holy rivers like the Ganges and visit various local deities. If Ketu is in a quadrant or trine, or even if it is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the lord of the major period: ॥ 19 ॥ the person will be capable, possess a righteous mind, experience happiness, and meet with the king. ॥ 20 ॥ If Ketu is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the Ascendant or the lord of the major period: ॥ 21 ॥ there will be fear of accidental death, the consumption of poor-quality food, suffering from cold fevers, diarrhea, ulcers, and trouble from thieves. ॥ 21 ॥ Separation from one's wife and sons is certain to occur in one's domestic life. If Ketu is placed in the second or seventh house, there will be physical pain. ॥ 22 ॥ One should perform the charity of a goat <note>a traditional ritual remedy</note> to remove the fear of accidental death. ॥ 23 ॥

### Now, the Results of the Sub-period of the Sun: 11 Months and 12 Days.

When the Sun <term>Surya</term> is in its sub-period within the major period of Saturn <term>Manda</term>, and is in its sign of exaltation or its own sign, or is joined with the lord of the ninth house, or is placed in a cardinal, gainful, or trine house <term>Trikona</term>: ॥ 37 ॥ or if it is aspected by beneficial planets, there will be great happiness from one's master. It brings the death of a relative and the separation from dear friends. ॥ 41 ॥ If the Sun is the lord of the second or seventh house, there will be suffering of the body. To remove these afflictions, one should arrange for the worship of the Sun <note>original: "Surya-puja"</note>. ॥ 42 ॥

## The Results of the Moon’s Sub-period (19 months, 0 days).

During the sub-period <term>Bhukti</term> of the Moon within the major period of Saturn <term>Manda</term>, if the Moon is aspected by Jupiter <term>Jiva</term>, is in its sign of exaltation, its own sign, a cardinal house <term>Kendra</term>, a trine <term>Trikona</term>, or the house of gains (the eleventh): ॥ 43 ॥ Or if the Moon is full and associated with beneficial planets, the person will enjoy the favor and company of royalty. Through the grace of a "Great King" <note>likely representing a high-ranking official or patron in a modern context</note>, one obtains vehicles, fine clothing, and jewelry. ॥ 44 ॥ There will be good fortune, an increase in happiness, and protection from untimely death. One will find joy in the families of both the father and mother, and an increase in livestock will bring comfort. ॥ 45 ॥

However, if the Moon is waning, associated with or aspected by malefic planets, in its sign of debilitation <note>its weakest point</note>, or located in harsh subdivisions or signs: ॥ 46 ॥ the individual will face great hardship, royal displeasure, and the loss of wealth. There may be separation from parents and illnesses affecting one's children. ॥ 47 ॥ Efforts in business will fail to bear fruit, and wealth will be drained through various channels. One may suffer from irregular meals and the need to constantly take medicine <note>indicating chronic illness</note>. ॥ 48 ॥ 

If the Moon is well-placed in a cardinal house, trine, or the house of gains relative to the lord of the major period <note>Saturn</note>, there will be happiness and the arrival of wealth at the beginning of the period. ॥ 49 ॥ This is followed by the acquisition of vehicles and clothing, an increase in the number of brothers, and general comfort. One attains happiness from parents, joy from a spouse, and financial gains. ॥ 50 ॥ Through the influence of friends and masters, one’s desires are met, bringing universal happiness and auspiciousness. 

But if the Moon is placed in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the lord of the major period and lacks planetary strength: ॥ 51 ॥ it brings confinement to bed, illness, laziness, loss of position, and a lack of comfort. It causes an increase in enemies, opposition, and separation from beloved kinsmen. ॥ 52 ॥ If the Moon is the lord of the second or seventh house <note>known as "killer" houses or Maraka-sthana</note>, there will be physical lethargy. To pacify these ill effects, one should perform a sesame-seed sacrifice <term>Tila-homa</term> and other rituals. ॥ 53 ॥ One should ritualistically offer jaggery, clarified butter <term>Ghee</term>, and rice mixed with yogurt. Giving a white cow or a buffalo as a gift will promote longevity and health. ॥ 54 ॥

One will enjoy royal favor, happiness, vehicles, clothing, and ornaments. ॥ 56 ॥ There will be a rise in military rank <note>original: "senādhikyaṃ", leadership over an army</note>, the king’s affection, and prosperity through agriculture, cattle, and grain. ## The Results of Rahu’s Sub-period (34 months, 6 days).

During the sub-period <term>Bhukti</term> of Rahu within the major period of Saturn, there will be quarrels, mental distress, and physical pain. The individual may suffer from internal grief, hatred from their own children, and psychological illness. ॥ 63 ॥ One may face the loss of money, fear of the government <note>original: "royal fear"</note>, and trouble from relatives. It may lead to foreign travel and the destruction of one's home and lands. ॥ 64 ॥ 

However, if Rahu is associated with the lord of the first house <term>Lagna-adhipa</term> or a planet of great fortune <term>Yoga-karaka</term>: ॥ 65 ॥ Or if Rahu is in its sign of exaltation, its own sign, a cardinal house <term>Kendra</term>, or in the eleventh house <note>the house of gains</note> relative to the lord of the major period: ॥ 66 ॥ At first, there will be happiness, the acquisition of wealth, and prosperity in land and home. The person will feel devotion toward the Divine and learned people <term>Brahmins</term>, and will undertake pilgrimages. ॥ 67 ॥ There will be a gain of livestock and an increase in auspicious celebrations within the home. However, in the middle of this period, there may be fear of the government and disagreements with children and friends. ॥ 68 ॥ 

If Rahu is placed in the signs of Aries, Virgo, Cancer, Taurus, Pisces, Sagittarius, or Leo: ॥ 69 ॥ the text predicts "Elephant-like" wealth <note>meaning immense prosperity</note>. One will receive honors from the government, gain land, and enjoy the comfort of fine, soft clothing. But if Rahu is associated with the lords of the second or seventh houses <note>the 'killer' houses</note>, there will be physical illness. ॥ 70 ॥ In that case, one should perform the Victory-over-Death <term>Mrityunjaya</term> ritual, gift a goat, and gift a bull to bring about all forms of prosperity and happiness. ॥ 71 ॥

### Now, the results of the sub-period of Mercury within the major period of Mercury (Duration: 22 months, 27 days).

There will be the gain of pearls and corals, and happiness derived from knowledge and right actions. One gains importance in education, fame, and an audience with a new king <note>or high-ranking official</note>. ॥ 1 ॥ There will be prosperity and happiness for the wife, children, father, and mother. If Mercury is joined with debilitated or cruel planets, or is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses: ॥ 2 ॥ or if it is associated with or aspected by malefics, there will be a loss of wealth, grains, and livestock. There will be opposition from one's own relatives and the possibility of shooting pains <term>Shula-roga</term> <note>often referring to colic or sharp abdominal pain</note>. ॥ 3 ॥

One will surely become anxious due to royal or administrative affairs. If Mercury is the lord of the second or seventh house, there will be distress for the wife. ॥ 4 ॥ There may be the death of a close relative or the onset of wind-related shooting pains <term>Vata-shula</term>. To remove these ill effects, one should chant the thousand names of Vishnu <term>Vishnu-Sahasranama</term>. ॥ 5 ॥

### Results of the Sub-period of Ketu: 11 months and 27 days

When the sub-period of **Ketu** occurs within the major period of **Mercury**, and if Ketu is placed in a quadrant <term>Kendra</term> <note>the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses</note> or a trine <term>Trikona</term> <note>the 1st, 5th, or 9th houses</note> from the ascendant; or if it is associated with or aspected by benefic planets, or joined with the lord of the ascendant; ॥ 6 ॥

Or if Ketu has a relationship with a planet that brings great success <term>Yoga-karaka</term> and is placed in the quadrant or the eleventh house from the lord of the major period <note>Mercury</note>: there will be physical comfort, the acquisition of modest wealth <note>original: "dhanalpatvam"; literally "smallness of wealth," implying steady but limited gains</note>, and help and affection from relatives. ॥ 7 ॥

One will gain four-legged animals <note>livestock such as cows or horses</note>, but there may be some physical distress or "heat" in the family life. There will be opportunities for learning and the acquisition of fame, as well as meetings with influential people of equal status. ॥ 8 ॥

One will enjoy good food and clothing; the beginning and middle of the period will be particularly happy. However, if Ketu is placed in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses <note>the "dusthanas" or houses of loss and difficulty</note> from the major period lord, or if it is in the eighth house associated with malefic planets: ॥ 9 ॥

There will be a danger of falling from vehicles, and the person will be troubled by distress regarding their sons. There will be fear of thieves and the government <note>original: "raja-bhiti"; literally "fear of the king"</note>, and the person may lean toward sinful actions. ॥ 10 ॥

There will be fear of poison from scorpions and similar creatures, and quarrels with low-minded people. One will experience grief, disease, and other sorrows, and the domestic life will become unstable. ॥ 11 ॥

If Ketu is the lord of the second or the seventh house <note>the Maraka or "death-inflicting" houses</note>, there will be physical illness. To remove these evil effects, one should perform the charity of a goat <term>Chchaga-dana</term>. ॥ 12 ॥

### Results of the Sub-period of Venus: 34 months

When the sub-period of **Venus** <term>Shukra</term> occurs within the major period of **Mercury**, if Venus is in a quadrant, the eleventh house, or a trine: there will be an accumulation of religious merit through listening to sacred stories and performing virtuous deeds. ॥ 13 ॥

Due to the influence of friends and authorities, one’s desires will be fulfilled, and there will be happiness and the acquisition of land. Even if Venus is in a quadrant, trine, or the eleventh house relative to the lord of the major period: ॥ 14 ॥

At that time, one attains prosperity, royal splendor, and wealth. There will be the performance of charitable acts such as building step-wells, wells, and reservoirs. ॥ 15 ॥

There will be great profit from professional work and an abundance of wealth and grains. But if Venus is in the sixth or eighth houses from the major period lord, or in the twelfth house, or is lacking in strength: ॥ 16 ॥

One will suffer from heart disease, loss of honor, and afflictions like fever and dysentery. There will be separation from one's own kinsmen, and the domestic life will lack peace. ॥ 17 ॥

Even if there is personal comfort, there will be mental agony regarding income and expenditure. If Venus is the lord of the second or seventh house, there is a risk of untimely death <term>Apamrityu</term>. ॥ 18 ॥

To remove these evil effects, one should perform the recitation <term>Japa</term> of the Goddess **Durga**. ॥ 19 ॥

### Results of the Sub-period of the Sun: 10 months and 6 days

When the sub-period of the **Sun** <term>Surya</term> occurs within the major period of **Mercury**, if the Sun is in its sign of exaltation <note>Aries</note>, in its own sign <note>Leo</note>, or in a quadrant; or in a trine, the house of wealth <note>the 2nd</note>, or the house of gains <note>the 11th</note>, or in its highest divisional strength <term>Tungamsha</term>: ॥ 20 ॥

One will receive royal favors and good fortune, and gain through the influence of friends and lords...

## Results of the Sub-period of the Moon: 10 months, 0 days

When the sub-period of the **Moon** <term>Chandra-bhukti</term> occurs within the major period of **Mercury**, and if the Moon is placed in a quadrant <term>Kendra</term> or a trine <term>Trikona</term> from the ascendant; or if it is in its sign of exaltation or its own sign, and is aspected by Jupiter: ॥ 26 ॥

Due to its lordship over auspicious houses, one should predict a great increase in success. There will be the gain of a wife and sons, as well as fine clothes, vehicles, and jewelry. ॥ 27 ॥

One will acquire a new house and enjoy sweet food daily. There will be involvement with music and instruments, and a dedicated effort toward the study of scriptures and sciences. ॥ 28 ॥

There will be a journey toward the southern direction. One will also gain textiles and clothing from other islands or foreign lands. ॥ 29 ॥

One will acquire pearls, coral, gems, and fine washed garments. However, if the Moon is in a debilitated sign or the sign of an enemy, there will be physical distress. ॥ 30 ॥

If the Moon is in a quadrant or trine from the lord of the major period <note>Mercury</note>, or in the third or eleventh house: at the beginning of the sub-period, there will be pilgrimages to holy riverbanks and sightings of deities in temples. ॥ 31 ॥

It will bring mental courage, enthusiasm of the heart, and wealth from foreign lands. But if the Moon is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the lord of the major period, or joined with malefic planets: ॥ 32 ॥

There will be fear of thieves, fire, and the government <note>original: "nṛpa"; literally "the king"</note>, and one may indulge in improper company with women. One will commit bad deeds, lose wealth, and suffer the loss of agriculture, cows, and horses. ॥ 33 ॥

If the Moon is the lord of the second or seventh house, there will be bodily pain. To remedy this, one should perform the ritual chanting for the Goddess Durga <term>Durga-devi-japam</term>. ॥ 34 ॥

One should also donate clothes, which will bring an increase in lifespan and happiness. ॥ 35 ॥

If Mars is the lord of the second or seventh houses <note>the "death-inflicting" houses</note>, there will be a fear of untimely death. ॥ 45 ॥ To remedy this, one should donate a bull <note>original: "anadvaham"</note> and perform the "Death-Conquering" chant <term>Mrityunjaya Japa</term>. ॥ 46 ॥

At the start of the sub-period, there may be bodily pain, but happiness should be predicted for the end. ॥ 49 ॥

If Rahu is placed in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses, there will be a loss of wealth during that sub-period. At the beginning of the sub-period, there will be physical decay, wind-related fever <term>Vata-jvara</term>, and indigestion. ॥ 50 ॥

If Rahu is in the houses of improvement <term>Upachaya</term> <note>the 3rd, 6th, 10th, or 11th houses</note> from the Ascendant and joined with beneficial planets: there will be satisfaction through conversations with the king and a meeting with a new master or lord. ॥ 51 ॥

If Rahu is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses from the lord of the major period, or joined with malefic planets: there will be harshness in royal/official business and a great fear of displacement from one's position. ॥ 52 ॥ There will be imprisonment and suffering from disease...

## Now, the results of the Sub-period of **Jupiter** <term>Guru-bhukti</term>: 27 months and [some] days.

In the major period of Mercury, if Jupiter <note>original: "Jiva"</note> is placed in an angle, a trine, its sign of exaltation, its own sign, the eleventh house of gain, or in the sign of Sagittarius: ॥ 56 ॥ There will be physical comfort, the attainment of wealth, and favor from the king <note>or government</note>. If it is in the second or seventh house, bodily distress will occur. ॥ 65 ॥ To remedy these faults, one should recite the Thousand Names of Shiva <term>Shiva-Sahasrakam</term>. By giving a cow, land, or gold in charity, all misfortunes are removed. ॥ 66 ॥

# Now, the results of the Sub-period of Ketu: 4 months and 6 days.

If Ketu is located in an angle <term>Kendra</term>, a trine <term>Trikona</term>, or the eleventh house of gain, or if it is associated with the lord of the Ascendant, or connected to the houses of fortune <note>9th</note> or action <note>10th</note>, or associated with the lord of the fourth house <note>vehicles</note>: ॥ 1 ॥ During its sub-period, there will be gains of wealth, grain, and four-legged animals. There will be happiness from sons and wife, favor from the king, but also some mental anxiety. ॥ 2 ॥ One may gain villages and lands, and the home will be filled with cattle and wealth. If Ketu is associated with a planet in its sign of debilitation or a combust planet, or is located in the eighth or twelfth houses: ॥ 3 ॥ Heart disease, loss of honor, and destruction of wealth, grain, and livestock will occur. There will be suffering for the wife and children, as well as mental instability. ॥ 4 ॥ If Ketu is associated with or located in the second or seventh house <note>the "killer" houses</note>, there will be ill health, great hardship, and separation from one's own kinsmen. ॥ 5 ॥ To remedy this, one should perform the ritual recitation of Goddess Durga and the Mrityunjaya mantra. ॥ 6 ॥

# Now, the results of the Sub-period of Venus <term>Shukra-bhukti</term>: 24 months and 0 days.

In the major period of Ketu, if Venus <note>original: "Shukra"</note> is in its sign of exaltation, its own sign, an angle, a trine, the house of gain, or associated with the lord of the tenth house <note>the "lord of the kingdom"</note>: ॥ 7 ॥ There will be royal favor, good fortune, and an abundance of fine royal garments. At that time, one attains prosperity <note>Shri</note> if Venus is associated with the lords of the ninth <note>fortune</note> or tenth <note>action</note> houses. ॥ 8 ॥ One will experience the recovery of lost kingdom and wealth, and possess excellent vehicles. There will be great pilgrimages, such as bathing at Setu <note>the sacred bridge at Rameshwaram</note>, and sightings <term>Darshana</term> of great deities. ॥ 9 ॥ Through the grace of a great king, one gains villages and land. If Venus is in an angle, a trine, the third house <term>Duschikya</term>, or the eleventh house of gain from the lord of the major period [Ketu]: ॥ 10 ॥ There will be bodily health, auspiciousness, and festive celebrations <term>Kalyana</term> in the home. One will gain fine food, clothing, and ornaments, and acquire horses and palanquins <term>Dola</term>. ॥ 11 ॥

## Now, the results of the Sun's sub-period: 4 months and 6 days.

During the sub-period <term>Antardasha</term> of the Sun <note>original: "Surya"</note> within the major period of Ketu, if the Sun is in its sign of exaltation, its own sign, or located in an angle <term>Kendra</term>, a trine <term>Trikona</term>, or the eleventh house of gain, or is aspected by auspicious planets: ॥ 16 ॥

There will be travel to foreign lands, as well as distress from thieves, snakes, or poison. Opposition from the King and friends will arise, and there will be a loss of wealth due to royal punishment. ॥ 19 ॥

There will be fear of sorrow and disease, and a fever caused by excessive bodily heat <note>original: "Ushna-adhikyam"</note> will occur. If the Sun is in an angle, a trine, the house of gain, or the house of wealth from the lord of the major period [Ketu]: ॥ 20 ॥

There will be physical comfort, gain of wealth, the birth of a son, and mental fortitude. The traveler's objectives will be successful, and one may even gain authority over a small village. ॥ 21 ॥

If the Sun is in an angle, the twelfth house <term>Ripha</term>, or the sixth house from the lord of the major period, or is joined with malefic planets: there will be obstacles regarding food, mental fear, and the loss of wealth, grain, and cattle. ॥ 22 ॥

One should predict great distress at the beginning and in the middle of the period, but happiness at the end. If the Sun is the lord of the second or seventh house, there will be the possibility of an untimely death. ॥ 23 ॥

One should perform a peaceful ritual <term>Shanti</term> related to the New Moon <note>original: "Darsha"</note> and donate a golden cow. ॥ 24 ॥

There will be significant profit from businesses involving food, water <note>original: "Amba"</note>, and cattle. There will be the gain of horses and vehicles, as well as clothes and jewelry...

# Results of the Sub-period of Mars: 4 Months and 27 Days.

During the sub-period <term>Antardasha</term> of Mars <note>original: "Bhauma" or "Kuja"</note> within the major period of Ketu: if Mars is in an angle or trine from the Ascendant, or is in its sign of exaltation or its own sign, or is aspected by auspicious planets: ॥ 37 ॥

In the beginning, there will be auspicious results, such as the gain of villages and land. There will be gains of wealth, grain, and four-legged livestock. ॥ 38 ॥

One will acquire houses, gardens, and fields, and enjoy the splendor of royal favor. If Mars is associated with the lords of the ninth <term>Bhagya</term> or tenth <term>Karma</term> houses, there will be gains of land and general happiness. ॥ 39 ॥

If Mars is in an angle, trine, third, or eleventh house from the lord of the major period: one will receive royal favor and fame, and happiness from sons and friends. ॥ 40 ॥

If Mars is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the lord of the major period, or even in the second house: it quickly brings death-like suffering, travel to foreign lands, calamities, and aimless wandering. ॥ 41 ॥

There may be suffering from urinary disorders <term>Prameha</term>, painful urination <term>Mutrakrichra</term>, or harassment from thieves and the king. Though there may be a slight increase in happiness elsewhere, quarrels will lead to distress. ॥ 42 ॥

If Mars is the lord of the second or seventh house, there will be distress from heat, fever, and poisons. One's wife will suffer, and there will be mental anguish and fear of untimely death. ॥ 43 ॥

To remedy this, one should donate an ox <term>Anadwaha</term>, which brings all forms of wealth and happiness. ॥ 44 ॥

# First Section, Chapter 44: The Results of the Sub-periods of Ketu in the Vimshottari System

## The Sub-period of Rahu: 12 Months, 0 Days — Its Results

When the sub-period <term>Antardasha</term> of Rahu occurs within the major period of Ketu: if Rahu is placed in its sign of exaltation, in a friend’s sign, or its own sign; or if it is placed in an angle <term>Kendra</term>, a trine <term>Trikona</term>, the eleventh house of gains <term>Labha</term>, the third house <term>Duschikya</term>, or the second house of wealth <term>Dhana</term>. ॥ 45 ॥

At that time, there will certainly be a gain of wealth and stability in one's domestic life. One will experience happiness through the favor of a foreign ruler <note>original: "Mlechcha-prabhu", referring to someone outside the traditional Vedic social structure</note> and will obtain wealth, grains, and various fruits of labor. ॥ 46 ॥

There will be gains of four-legged animals <note>livestock</note> and the acquisition of villages and lands. While one may face some distress at the very beginning of the sub-period, the middle and end will bring happiness. ॥ 47 ॥

However, if Rahu is placed in the eighth or twelfth houses, or is associated with or aspected by malefic planets: although one may have many sons, the body will become weak, and there will be fear from "cold fever" and poisons. ॥ 48 ॥

One may suffer from quartan fever <note>a fever that recurs every third day</note>, harassment from petty people, sudden quarrels, urinary disorders <term>Prameha</term>, and piercing colic pain <term>Shula</term>. ॥ 49 ॥

If Rahu is in the second or seventh houses <note>known as "Maraka" or killer houses</note>, then great distress and intense fear will occur. To remove these evils, one should perform the recitation <term>Japa</term> of the Goddess Durga. A fire sacrifice of ten thousand offerings <term>Ayuta Homa</term> should be performed, which bestows all forms of happiness. ॥ 50 ॥

---

## The Sub-period of Jupiter: 11 Months, 0 Days — Its Results

When the sub-period of Jupiter <note>original: "Guru" or "Jiva"</note> occurs within Ketu: if Jupiter is in an angle, the eleventh house, or a trine; or if it is in its sign of exaltation or its own sign, or associated with the lord of the first house <term>Lagna</term>. ॥ 51 ॥

If it is joined with the lords of the tenth <term>Karma</term> and ninth <term>Bhagya</term> houses, there will be prosperity in wealth, grains, and assets. One will enjoy the favor of the king <note>the government or authorities</note>, mental enthusiasm, and the acquisition of horses and palanquins <note>symbols of high social status and luxury transport</note>. ॥ 52 ॥

There will be auspicious wealth and prosperity in the home, the birth of a son, and grand celebrations. One will feel the urge to visit holy pilgrimage sites, and one's good deeds will bring great comfort. ॥ 53 ॥

By the grace of one's personal deity <term>Ishta Devata</term>, success in undertakings and gains in work will be achieved. There will be opportunities for conversation with royalty and meetings with new influential leaders. ॥ 54 ॥

If Jupiter is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses from the lord of the major period <note>Ketu</note>, or if it is in its sign of debilitation: there will be fear of thieves, snakes, and wounds, as well as the destruction of wealth and grains. ॥ 55 ॥

Separation from wife and sons may occur, and there is the possibility of extreme distress. In this placement, the beginning may be auspicious, but the end will bring trouble. ॥ 56 ॥

If Jupiter is in an angle or trine from the major period lord, or in the third or eleventh houses: if it is joined by auspicious planets, there will be favor from the king and the acquisition of extraordinary garments and ornaments. ॥ 57 ॥

There will be travel to distant lands and the ability to support one’s own kinsmen. While there will be plenty of food, clothing, and animals, there may be some physical pain at the start of the sub-period. ॥ 58 ॥

At the end, however, there may be a change of location <note>displacement</note> and sudden quarrels may arise.

If the planet is the lord of the second or seventh houses <note>original: "dyūna-nātha", referring to the 7th house of partnerships and death</note>, there will be a danger of untimely death. ॥ 59 ॥ To ward off that defect, one should chant the "Thousand Names of Shiva." The chanting of the *Great Victory Over Death* mantra <term>Maha Mrityunjaya: a famous Vedic chant for health and immortality</term> destroys all calamities. ॥ 60 ॥

## The Sub-period of Saturn: 16 Months, 09 Days — Its Results

When Saturn occurs as the sub-period <term>Antardasha</term> within its own major period of Ketu, there will be suffering. There will be distress to kinsmen and mental worry, yet it also brings the gain of four-legged animals <note>livestock or wealth-producing animals</note>. ॥ 61 ॥

Through involvement in royal or government affairs, there may be loss of wealth and great fear. One might experience displacement from their position, travel, and the fear of thieves on the road. ॥ 62 ॥

If Saturn is located in the eighth or twelfth house (the house of loss), there will be laziness and a decline in mental strength. However, if Saturn is in Pisces or a trine <term>Trikona</term>, or in Libra (its sign of exaltation), or in its own sign. ॥ 63 ॥

Or if it is in an angle <term>Kendra</term>, a trine, the house of gains, the third house <term>Duschikya</term>, or in a benefic division of the zodiac; and if the sub-period ends with aspects from beneficial planets, then all objectives and tasks will be accomplished. ॥ 64 ॥

One will receive great happiness from their master or ruler, and gain from travels or competitions <note>original: "rana", literally battle or conflict</note>. There will be happiness and prosperity in one's own village and an audience with the king alongside one's family. ॥ 65 ॥

If Saturn is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the major period lord <note>Ketu</term>, or is joined by malefic planets: there will be fever in the body, mental distress, obstacles in work, and great fear. ॥ 66 ॥

Laziness, loss of honor, and the passing away of parents may occur. If Saturn is the lord of the second or seventh house, there will be fear of untimely death. ॥ 67 ॥

To remedy these defects, one should perform a fire sacrifice with sesame seeds <term>Tila Homa</term>. One should donate a black cow or a buffalo, which bestows an increase in both lifespan and health. ॥ 68 ॥

## The Sub-period of Mercury: 11 Months, 27 Days — Its Results

When Mercury <note>original: "Saumye", the gentle one</note> is the sub-period within Ketu and is placed in an angle, a house of gain, or a trine; or if it is in its exaltation or its own sign: there will be the gain of authority <note>original: "rajya-labho", gain of a kingdom</note> and great happiness. ॥ 69 ॥

The person will take pleasure in hearing virtuous stories, giving charity, and finding success in religious duties. There will be gain of land, the birth of a son, gatherings with auspicious people, and the arrival of wealth. ॥ 70 ॥

Righteous wealth will be obtained without much effort, and a marriage will take place. In the home, there will be auspicious events and the acquisition of clothes and jewelry. ॥ 71 ॥

If Mercury is joined with the lords of the house of fortune (9th) or action (10th), there will be a pleasant increase in fortune. Through discourse and gatherings with scholars, one will find satisfaction <note>original: "santapo", likely a scribal error for "santosho" (satisfaction/delight) given the context of ornaments</note> and receive ornaments. ॥ 72 ॥

If Mercury is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house, or is joined or aspected by Saturn, Mars, or Rahu: there will be opposition in government affairs and one may have to live in another person’s house. ॥ 73 ॥

This brings the destruction of vehicles, clothing, animals, wealth, and grains. The beginning of the sub-period is said to be auspicious, while the middle brings happiness and the arrival of wealth. ॥ 74 ॥

At the end of the period, there will be distress and suffering for one's wife and children.
