There will be bodily health, great profits, the well-being of sons, and general prosperity. One will see increased results in matters of food, clothing, livestock, and business. ॥ 76 ॥

If the sub-period lord is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the major period lord, or is lacking in strength, then the beginning of that sub-period will bring great distress and suffering to the wife and children. ॥ 77 ॥

It will cause fear of the government <note>original: "rāja-bhīti", fear of the king</note>, though in the middle of the period, one may undertake a pilgrimage to a holy site <note>original: "tīrtha-kara"</note>. If the planet is the lord of the second or seventh houses <note>original: "dūta-nātha", houses associated with death</note>, there will be a danger of untimely death. To ward off that defect, one should chant the "Thousand Names of Vishnu" <note>original: "viṣṇusahasrakaṃ"</note>. ॥ 78 ॥

# Now, the Sub-period of Venus within the Major Period of Venus: 40 Months, 00 Days — Its Results.

When the sub-period of Venus <term>Shukra-bhukti</term> occurs within the major period of Venus <term>Bhrigu</term>, and if it is situated in an angle or a trine from the ascendant <term>Lagna</term>. ॥ 1 ॥

Or if it is in the house of gains and endowed with strength, one should predict the full power of its beneficial combinations <term>Yoga</term>. There will be the acquisition of wealth through priests or learned men <note>original: "vipra-mūlāt"</note>, and gains of cows and buffaloes. ॥ 2 ॥

It brings joy through festivals for the birth of sons and the occurrence of auspicious events in the home. One receives honors, including royal recognition, the gain of territory, and great happiness. If Venus is in its sign of exaltation <note>Pisces</note>, its own sign <note>Taurus or Libra</note>. ॥ 3 ॥

Or in its highest divisional strength, one will build a new house and enjoy sweet food daily. There will be prosperity for the wife and sons and the pleasure of dining with friends. ॥ 4 ॥

One will find delight in the daily distribution of food and the collection of merit through charity and religious duties. By the grace of the Great King, one will receive vehicles, clothing, and jewelry. ॥ 5 ॥

There will be an abundance of profit from agriculture and business, and gains from four-legged animals. Travel toward the western direction will result in the acquisition of vehicles and fine garments. ॥ 6 ॥

If Venus is in the houses of improvement <term>Upachaya: the 3rd, 6th, 10th, or 11th houses</term> from the ascendant, and is aspected by or joined with beneficial planets, or if it is in a friend's division or the house of gains. ॥ 7 ॥

One will gain authority over a region, experience great enthusiasm, and receive beneficial royal favor. There will be the arrival of auspicious wealth in the home and the flourishing of wife and children. ॥ 8 ॥

If Venus is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house, or is joined with or aspected by malefic planets, there will be fear of thieves and wounds, and distress from people everywhere. ॥ 9 ॥

## Now, the Results of the Sub-period of the Sun: 12 Months, 2 Days.

During the sub-period of the Sun within the major period of Venus, there will be distress arising from the government <note>original: "rāja-viṅgu-jam"</note>, quarrels with kinsmen, or legal disputes. ॥ 12 ॥ 

If the Sun is in its sign of exaltation, its own sign, or a friendly sign, and is positioned in an angle <term>Kendra: the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses</term> or a trine <term>Trikona: the 1st, 5th, or 9th houses</term>, or if it is in the houses of gain or wealth from the lord of the major period <note>Venus</note>. ॥ 13 ॥ 

In that sub-period, there will be gain of wealth, gains from the state, women, and property. One will experience great happiness from their superior or master <note>original: "svaprabho"</note> and the meeting of dear relatives. ॥ 14 ॥ 

One attains happiness for their parents, beneficial gains of brothers, good fame, happiness, fortune, and the birth of a son. ॥ 15 ॥ 

If the Sun is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house, or is in its sign of debilitation or in the divisions of malefic planets, there will be distress from fire or fever and mental anguish. ॥ 16 ॥ 

There will be great distress from one's own people, the constant hearing of harsh speech, suffering for the father, loss of relatives, and opposition at the royal court. ॥ 17 ॥ 

There will be suffering from ulcers or wounds, danger from snakes, and fear even when in one's own sign or home. Various diseases may bring fear, and there may be the destruction of house and lands. ॥ 18 ॥ 

Due to the defect of the seventh house lordship <term>Maraka</term>, there will be planetary affliction. To remove that defect, one should perform rituals to please the Sun. ॥ 19 ॥

## Now, the Results of the Sub-period of the Moon: 20 Months, 00 Days.

When the Moon is in the sub-period of Venus and is placed in an angle, the house of gains, or a trine, or is in its sign of exaltation or its own sign, or is associated with the lords of the ninth <note>fortune</note> or tenth <note>career/actions</note> houses. ॥ 20 ॥ 

If it is associated with a benefic planet, is a full moon, or is joined with the lord of the kingdom, that sub-period will bring great happiness through an abundance of vehicles and children. ॥ 21 ॥ 

By the grace of a great king <note>or high official</note>, one should predict prosperity as grand as owning elephants. There will be the religious merit of bathing in a great river and the worship of gods and priests. ॥ 22 ॥ 

There will be the enjoyment of music and instruments, and one will be adorned by the company of learned people. There will be an increase in cattle, buffaloes, and the like, and great results in business ventures. ॥ 23 ॥ 

One will find comfort in food and clothing and enjoy meals with relatives. However, if the Moon is debilitated, combust, or situated in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses... ॥ 24 ॥

If the lord of the sub-period is placed in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the lord of the major period <note>Venus</note>, at that time there will be a loss of wealth and a great deal of fear will be encountered. ॥ 25 ॥ There will be physical exhaustion, mental distress, and opposition at the royal court <note>original: "rāja-dvāre", meaning government or legal trouble</note>. ### Now, the results of the sub-period of Mars: 14 Months, 0 Days.

During the sub-period of Mars within the major period of Venus, if Mars is in an angle or a trine from the Ascendant <term>Lagna: the rising sign</term>, or if Mars is in its sign of exaltation, its own sign, or the eleventh house with strength, ॥ 30 ॥ or if it is joined with the Lord of the Ascendant or the lords of the ninth or tenth houses, then in that sub-period, there will be "royal yoga" <note>combinations for success and status</note>, prosperity, and auspicious celebrations. ॥ 31 ॥ 

There will be the fulfillment of desires regarding clothing, jewelry, and land, bringing much happiness. However, if Mars is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth houses, or if it is placed similarly from the lord of the major period <note>Venus</note>, ॥ 32 ॥ there will be suffering from cold fevers and fear regarding one's father and mother. There will be an increase in diseases like fevers, a fall from one's position, and mental agony. ॥ 33 ॥ 

There will be harm to one's own kinsmen, quarrels, and distress from the government <note>original: "rāja-vijvaram"</note>. There will be public hatred at the royal court and excessive expenditure of wealth and grain. ॥ 34 ॥ The fruits of one's profession will not be desirable, even if there is some gain of village or land. If Mars is the lord of the second or seventh houses <term>Maraka: houses of death</term>, there will be physical illness. ॥ 35 ॥

### Now, the results of the sub-period of Rahu: 30 Months, 0 Days.

During the sub-period of Rahu within the major period of Venus, if Rahu is in an angle, the house of gain, or a trine, or if it is in its sign of exaltation, aspected by benefics, or joined with a "yoga-karaka" planet <term>Yoga-karaka: a planet that brings great success</term>, ॥ 36 ॥ then in that sub-period, there will be much happiness and the gain of wealth and grain. One will be surrounded by beloved kinsmen and gain fine food and clothing. ॥ 37 ॥ 

There will be success in the business of a traveler <note>original: "yātuḥ", one who is journeying</note> and the acquisition of cattle and fields. If Rahu is in the "upachaya" houses <term>Upachaya: the 3rd, 6th, 10th, or 11th houses of improvement</term> from the Ascendant, its sub-period will be a giver of happiness. ॥ 38 ॥ There will be the destruction of enemies, great enthusiasm, and favorable royal favor.

## Now, the results of the sub-period of Jupiter: 32 Months, 0 Days.

During the sub-period of Jupiter <note>original: "Jiva", another name for Jupiter meaning 'the soul' or 'living being'</note> within the major period of Venus, if Jupiter is in its sign of exaltation <note>Cancer</note>, its own sign, or in an angle; or if it is in a favorable sign from the lord of the major period, or in the house of fortune <term>Bhagya: the 9th house</term> or the house of action <term>Karma: the 10th house</term>, ॥ 45 ॥ one attains wealth from a lost kingdom and gains desired objects, clothing, and prosperity. One enjoys happiness from celebrations such as the birth of a son and meetings with dear relatives. There will be happiness from parents and comfort provided by brothers and children. ॥ 48 ॥ 

If Jupiter is in the sixth or twelfth house from the lord of the major period, or is joined with malefic planets, there will be suffering from rulers, thieves, and the like, and physical pain will occur. ॥ 49 ॥ 

There will be distress for one's self and relatives, and mental agony due to quarrels. One may face displacement from one's position, foreign travel, and various diseases. ॥ 50 ॥ 

If Jupiter rules the second or seventh house <note>the 'killer' or Maraka houses</note>, there will be physical affliction. To remedy this affliction, one should perform the Great *Mrityunjaya* ceremony. ॥ 51 ॥

There is suffering regarding the wife and children, and at the conclusion <term>Samhāra: the end or withdrawal phase of a period</term>, there is mental and physical confusion. ॥ 56 ॥ Profits from business are lost, and it causes the loss of cows, buffaloes, and other livestock. If Saturn is the lord of the second or seventh house, there will be physical suffering. ॥ 57 ॥ To remove these afflictions, one should perform a sesame sacrifice <term>Tila-homam: a ritual where sesame seeds are offered into a consecrated fire to appease Saturn</term>. ॥ 58 ॥ He who gives a cow as a gift during the results of the dasha <note>major period</note> of the son of Bhrigu <note>Venus</note> always attains happiness and wealth equal to a king. One will possess excellence, fame, great victory, the gain of many kingdoms, and if born under the sun's portion, will be a possessor of great fortune. ॥ 59 ॥

# Now, the results of the sub-period of Mercury: 34 Months, 0 Days.

During the sub-period of Mercury <note>original: "Saumye", the gentle or lunar planet</note> within the major period of Venus, if Mercury is in a quadrant <term>Kendra: the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses</term>, a trine <term>Trikona: the 1st, 5th, or 9th houses</term>, or the eleventh house of gains; or if it is in its sign of exaltation or its own sign, it brings the favor of the king and is auspicious. ॥ 60 ॥ It brings good fortune, the birth of a son, and the acquisition of wealth through righteous paths. One listens to the sacred histories <term>Purāṇas: ancient Hindu texts detailing mythology and ethics</term> and the Law, and enjoys the company of beautiful people. ॥ 61 ॥ One is surrounded by beloved relatives and meets with learned priests <note>original: "Vipra"</note> and powerful lords. There is great happiness from one's own master and the daily enjoyment of sweet food. ॥ 62 ॥ If Mercury is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house from the lord of the major period, or is devoid of strength, or is seen by or joined with malefic planets, it causes the loss of four-legged animals. ॥ 63 ॥ There may be residence in another's house and the possibility of mental instability. As the sub-period passes, the acquisition of debts and wealth will be very slight. ॥ 64 ॥ The beginning of the sub-period is said to be beautiful; the middle is designated as happy. But at the end, it causes distress and ailments like cold, wind-related issues, and fever. ॥ 65 ॥ Due to the affliction of being the lord of the seventh house, physical pain will occur. To remove this affliction, one should recite the Thousand Names of Vishnu <note>original: "Viṣṇu-sahasrakam", a famous hymn to Lord Vishnu</note>. ॥ 66 ॥

There is great profit from business and an increase in cows, buffaloes, and other livestock. ॥ 68 ॥ There is prosperity in wealth and grains, and victory in battle will occur. At the end of the sub-period, there is indeed happiness and...

To remove these afflictions, one should perform the repetition of the Conqueror of Death mantra <note>original: "Mrityunjaya-japam", a powerful prayer to Lord Shiva for health and longevity</note>. ॥ 73 ॥ One should perform the donation of a goat, which bestows all forms of wealth and prosperity. ॥ 74 ॥

->Thus ends the forty-fifth chapter, titled "The Results of the Sub-periods of Venus," within the First Section of the Great Parashara Hora Shastra.<-

### Now, the section on Sub-sub-periods is explained.

Multiply the number of years of the sub-period by the years of the planet's own major period. Divide the total by one hundred and twenty; the result gives the days, and the remainder provides the minutes and further divisions of time. ॥ 1 ॥

### Now, an example for calculating the sub-sub-period is given.

In the sub-period of a planet where the sub-sub-period <note>original: "Upadasha", a further division of planetary time</note> of another planet is to be calculated: take the total years, months, and days of that sub-period and convert them all into days. Then, multiply that sum by the years of the major period of the planet whose sub-sub-period is being calculated. After that, divide the result by one hundred and twenty <note>original: "Vimsottari-shatena", referring to the 120-year cycle of the Vimsottari system</note>. The quotient gives the number of days. Multiply the remainder by sixty and divide again by one hundred and twenty to find the units of time <term>Ghatika: a traditional unit of time equal to 24 minutes</term>.

For example, in the sub-period of the Sun, the duration is 3 months and 18 days. These total 108 days. This "Sun-sum" <note>original: "Suryapinda"</note> of 108 is multiplied by the Sun’s own major period years, which is 6. This results in 648. Then, dividing by one hundred and twenty gives a quotient of 5 days. The remainder is 48, which, when multiplied by sixty, becomes 2880. Dividing this by one hundred and twenty gives 24 ghadikas, with no further remainder. Thus, within the Sun’s sub-period, the Sun’s own sub-sub-period consists of 5 days and 24 ghadikas. In the same way, when calculating the sub-sub-periods for the Moon and others within the Sun’s sub-period, the base number of days (108) remains the same; only the multiplier—the major period years of the Moon and others—is used. For instance, the Sun’s base sum is 108; the Moon’s major period years are 10. Multiplying these gives 1080. The rest of the calculation should be understood as before.

# Now begins the results of the sub-sub-periods.
<note>original: "अथ विदशाफलं प्रारभ्यते" (Atha vidaśāphalaṃ prārabhyate). This section shifts from mathematical tables to interpreting the effects of the shortest divisions in the planetary cycle.</note>

If the Lord of the Ascendant <note>original: "लग्नेश" (Lagneśa), the planet ruling the first house.</note> and the Lord of Sickness <note>original: "रोगनाथ" (Roganātha), the lord of the 6th house.</note> are joined with the Lord of the Eighth House <note>original: "निधनेन" (Nidhanena), the house of death and longevity.</note>, or are associated with or aspected by the "Death-inflicting" planets <note>original: "मारकेश" (Mārakeśa), planets designated as indicators of the end of life.</note>, or if they occupy the sub-division of the Lord of Sickness; ॥ 2 ॥ then during that sub-period, one should recognize that a person will suffer pain from weapons. If there is a connection with beneficial planets, there will be obstacles, but if connected with malefic planets, it causes death. ॥ 3 ॥

In the sub-division of Jupiter, use the Jupiter-class; in the sub-division of "the Root" <note>original: "मूलांशे" (Mūlāṃśe), likely referring to Moola Nakshatra or a specific divisional dignity.</note>, use the Root-class. Predict sickness and other results there according to the influence of their specific sub-periods. ॥ 4 ॥

When the lord of the ninth-part <note>original: "नवांशनाथ" (Navāṃśanātha).</note> of the Ascendant lord and the lord of the eighth-house sub-division are together, and if they are located in the six divisional charts <note>original: "षड्वर्ग" (Ṣaḍvarga).</note> of **Aries**, then during that sub-period, the wise man says there is fear from jackals <note>original: "जुबुक" (Jubuka), sometimes interpreted as a jackal or a hyena.</note>. ॥ 5 ॥

If they are in the divisions of **Taurus**, one should predict fear from scorpions. If they are in the divisions of **Gemini**, there is fear from monkeys—of this there is no doubt. ॥ 6 ॥ If they are in the divisions of **Cancer**, one should predict fear from donkeys. If they are in the divisions of **Leo**, there will be fear from tigers during that sub-period. ॥ 7 ॥ If they are in the divisions of **Virgo**, then fear from bears will certainly occur. If they are in the divisions of **Libra**, there will be fear from elephants in that sub-period. ॥ 8 ॥ For those whose planets are in the divisions of **Scorpio**, there will be fear from bulls.

<header>Chapter 46: Results of the Sub-sub-periods of the Sun and Others in the Vimshottari System</header>

If the two planets governing the sub-period are situated in the division of Sagittarius <note>original: "Karmuka-varga"</note>, there will be fear from elephants. || 9 || If those two are situated in the division of Capricorn <note>original: "Mriga-varga"</note>, there will be fear from camels or young elephants. If they are in the division of Aquarius <note>original: "Kumbha-varga"</note>, there will be fear from animals with long, swinging tails <note>such as monkeys or dogs</note>. || 10 || If they are in the division of Pisces <note>original: "Meena-varga"</note>, there will be fear from water-monsters <note>original: "rahaja," likely referring to crocodiles or sharks</note>. In this way, a wise man, the best among those who know the movements of time, should declare the results of the body and other houses by considering the movements through the six-fold divisions <term>Shadvarga: a system of six types of divisional charts used to assess planetary strength</term>. || 11 ||

# Now begins the description of the results for the sub-sub-periods of all planets, starting with the Sun.

**(Sun - Sun)** 
Anxiety, followed by loss of strength, distress concerning wealth and one’s wife, and pain in the head. There will also be disputes with a Brahmin <note>a member of the priestly or learned class</note> when the Sun enters its own sub-sub-period <note>original: "vidasha"</note>. || 12 ||

**(Sun - Moon)** 
Anxiety, quarrels, and a strange affliction of the mind and heart. There is also the loss of gems and pearls during the sub-sub-periods of the Moon within the Sun. || 13 ||

**(Sun - Mars)** 
Fear from the government <note>original: "raja," or the king</note>, fear of weapons, imprisonment, and many crises. One suffers from enemies and fire during the sub-periods of Mars within the Sun. || 14 ||

**(Sun - Rahu)** 
Phlegmatic diseases, fear of weapons, loss of wealth, and great terror. There is a downfall from one's position <note>original: "rajabhanga"</note> as well as fright during the sub-sub-period of the Dark One <note>original: "tamah," a name for Rahu</note> within the Sun. || 15 ||

**(Sun - Jupiter)** 
Destruction of enemies, victory, growth, and the acquisition of clothes, gold, and ornaments. Jupiter gives horses, vehicles, and wealth in cattle during the Sun's period. || 16 ||

**(Sun - Saturn)** 
Loss of wealth, suffering of cattle, great anxiety, and major illness. One encounters everything inauspicious during the sub-sub-period of Saturn within the Sun. || 17 ||

**(Sun - Mercury)** 
The acquisition of knowledge, meeting with kinsmen, obtaining fine food, and the arrival of wealth. One gains religious merit and receives honor from the government during the sub-sub-period of Mercury within the Sun. || 18 ||

**(Sun - Ketu)** 
Fear of death, great losses, fear of the government, and conflict. There are major arguments with enemies during the sub-sub-period of the Crested One <note>original: "shikhi," a name for Ketu</note> within the Sun. || 19 ||

**(Sun - Venus)** 
The days pass in a mediocre or uniform fashion, and any gains will be small. There is only a slight amount of happiness and prosperity during the sub-sub-period of the son of Bhrigu <note>original: "bhrigu," a name for Venus</note> within the Sun. || 20 ||

# Now begins the description of the results for the sub-sub-periods of the Moon.

**(Moon - Moon)** 
The acquisition of land, food, and wealth; honor from the government and great happiness. There are great gains and the enjoyment of women during the Moon's own sub-sub-period. || 21 ||

**(Moon - Mars)** 
The growth of intelligence— <note>The text breaks off here and continues on the next page.</note>

## Now the results of the sub-sub-periods of Rahu are described.

(Rahu - Rahu - Rahu) Various types of bondage <note>imprisonment or severe restriction of movement</note>, many diseases, numerous injuries, and the loss of friends. Sudden calamities arrive, and there is fear from water and fire during the sub-sub-period of Rahu within Rahu. || 39 ||

(Rahu - Rahu - Jupiter) One obtains profit everywhere, along with elephants, horses, and the arrival of wealth. This period brings royal honors and the acquisition of a kingdom when Jupiter is in the sub-sub-period of Rahu. || 40 ||

(Rahu - Rahu - Saturn) Terrible bondage occurs, along with a loss of happiness and great fear. (Rahu - Rahu - Mercury) There are various gains everywhere, especially through women. One finds success while traveling in foreign lands when Mercury is in the sub-sub-period of Rahu. || 42 ||

(Rahu - Rahu - Ketu) Destruction of intelligence, fear, obstacles, loss of wealth, and great dread. Conflict and distress manifest everywhere when the Crested One <term>Shikhi: a name for Ketu, the south node of the moon</term> is in the sub-sub-period of Rahu. || 43 ||

(Rahu - Rahu - Venus) Fear from the Yoginis <note>minor goddesses or spirits, often considered volatile</note>, fear from the king, the loss of horses, and the consumption of bad food. There is the loss of a wife and sorrow within the family when the Bright One <term>Sita: a name for Venus</term> is in the sub-sub-period of Rahu. || 44 ||

(Rahu - Rahu - Sun) Feverish illnesses, great dread, and the suffering of sons and grandsons. A "minor death" <note>a life-threatening illness or crisis</note> and negligence occur when the Sun is in the sub-sub-period of Rahu. || 45 ||

(Rahu - Rahu - Moon) Distress, conflict, anxiety, loss of honor, and great fear. There is a paternal weakness in the body when the Moon is in the sub-sub-period of Rahu. || 46 ||

(Rahu - Rahu - Mars) Suffering caused by fistulas <term>Bhagandara: a painful medical condition (anal fistula)</term> and distress from blood-bile disorders <term>Rakta-pitta: a condition in Ayurveda involving internal bleeding or skin eruptions</term>. There is loss of wealth and great distress when Mars is in the sub-sub-period of Rahu. || 47 ||

## Now, the Results of the Mercury Sub-sub-periods.

(Mercury - Mercury - Mercury) There is gain of intelligence, knowledge, and wealth, or the acquisition of clothing and great happiness. (Mercury - Mercury - Venus) There shall be gain from the North, but loss from four-legged animals <note>livestock</note>. There is great joy from the exercise of authority when Venus <note>original: "bhrigu"</note> is in the sub-sub-period of Mercury, within the sub-period of Mercury. || 68 ||

<header>First Section: Chapter 47 on the effects of the subtle planetary periods (Vimshottari Sun etc.)</header>

(Venus - Venus - Ketu) <note>original: "Shu. Ke." - refers to the sub-sub-sub period of Ketu within the sub-period of Venus and major period of Venus</note> There is a slight fear of death, and one may travel from one's country to another due to terrible circumstances. Thus ends the forty-sixth chapter, titled "The Statement of the Effects of the Sub-periods of the Sun and Others," in the Summary of the First Section of the *Brihat Parashara Hora*. || 46 ||

---

### Now, the method for calculating the subtle periods is stated.

Multiply the total number of <term>ghatikas</term> <note>a unit of time equal to 24 minutes; there are 60 ghatikas in a day</note> of the sub-period by the years assigned to the specific planet <note>in the 120-year Vimshottari system</note>. Divide this by 120. The quotient represents the <term>liptas</term> <note>minutes or primary units</note>, and the remainder is used to calculate the <term>kalas</term> <note>seconds or secondary units</note> and so on. || 1 ||

---

### Now, an example of calculating the subtle periods is stated.

To determine the <term>sukshma-dasha</term> <note>subtle or "sub-sub-sub" period</note> of any planet within a sub-period: take the total duration of that sub-period in months, days, and ghatikas, and convert it entirely into a total sum of ghatikas. Multiply this sum by the years of the planet in question. For example, if we are calculating the Moon's subtle period within the Sun's sub-period, multiply the Sun's total units by the Moon's 10 years. After multiplying by the planet's years, divide by 120. The resulting quotient gives the <term>ghatikas</term>. Multiply the remainder by 60 and divide by 120 to find the <term>palas</term> <note>a unit of 24 seconds</note>. Multiply that remainder again by 60 and divide as before to find the <term>aksharas</term> <note>the smallest units, literally the "time taken to speak a syllable"</note>.

As an example: The Sun’s sub-period is 5 days and 24 ghatikas <note>original: "6 | 24", though the math follows 5 | 24</note>. The total sum of ghatikas is 324. Multiplied by the Sun's own 6 years, this becomes 1944. Dividing this by 120, the quotient is 16 ghatikas, with a remainder of 24. Multiplying 24 by 60 gives 1440. Dividing 1440 by 120, the quotient is 12 palas. Thus, the period is 16 ghatikas and 12 palas. This logic should be applied to all planets. If the total days exceed 30, they should be converted into months.

## Now, the results of the Subtle Periods.

If the Lord of the Ascendant <note>the planet ruling the first house of the self</note> and the Lord of the 8th House <note>the planet ruling the house of death and longevity</note> are joined together in the sign of Taurus, in a Taurus <term>Navamsha</term> <note>a divisional chart representing one-ninth of a sign</note>, or in a Taurus <term>Drekkana</term> <note>a divisional chart representing one-third of a sign</note>, and if they are situated there, one should know that the cause of death will be from a bull. || 2 ||

If those two lords are in Taurus but in a Gemini Navamsha, death for men is caused by a bear. If they are in Taurus in a Cancer Navamsha, death occurs by a crocodile or in water. || 3 ||

If they are in Taurus in a Leo Navamsha, death is caused by an attack from a tiger or similar predator. If they are in Taurus in a Virgo Navamsha, it is by a monkey—of this there is no doubt. || 4 ||

If they are in Taurus in a Capricorn Navamsha, one should predict death by a buffalo. If they are in Taurus in an Aquarius Navamsha <note>the text repeats the Aquarius division here</note>, one should predict death from an iron tail <note>possibly a reference to a specific weapon or a tool</note>. || 7 ||

If they are in Taurus in a Pisces Navamsha, there will be fear from a goat or a ram. In this way, a wise person should contemplate and predict the death of brothers and others. || 8 ||

## Now, the method for bringing forth the Breath Period.

->Take the total amount of the Subtle Period converted into <term>Vighatikas</term><note>A unit of time equal to 24 seconds</note>. Multiply this by the planet's own years <-
->and then divide that sum by one hundred and twenty. <-
->The quotient is known as <term>Vighatikas</term>, and the remainder is <term>Vipalas</term>. <-
-> || 1 || <-

## Here is an example:

When calculating the <term>Prana-dasha</term> <note>The "breath period," the fifth and most refined level of time in this astrological system</note> of any planet within a specific Subtle Period, take the number of days and <term>Ghatikas</term> <note>A unit of 24 minutes</note> of that Subtle Period, convert them into <term>Palas</term> <note>another term for Vighatikas</note>, and multiply by the planet's specific years <note>The years assigned to each planet in the 120-year Vimshottari cycle</note>. The remaining operations are the same as for the Subtle Period. 

For instance, if the Subtle Period is 16 <term>Ghatis</term> and 12 <term>Palas</term>, we calculate the Breath Periods of all planets within it. Specifically, in the Subtle Period of the Sun, the total <term>Vighatikas</term> are 9 and 72 <note>This refers to the proportional units used in the calculation</note>. Multiplied by the Sun's 6 years, this becomes 58 and 132. Dividing by one hundred and twenty, the quotient is 48 <term>Palas</term>. The remainder is 72, which, when multiplied by sixty, becomes 4320. Dividing that again by the same divisor yields 36 <term>Vipalas</term>. 

Thus, within the Subtle Period of the Sun, the Sun's own Breath Period is 48 <term>Palas</term> and 36 <term>Vipalas</term>. In this manner, one should calculate the periods for all other planets.

### Now, the Results of the Sun's Breath Period.

**Sun—Sun:** During the <term>Breath Period</term><note>The "Prana-dasha," the most granular level of the Vimshottari Dasha system, lasting only a few hours or days.</note> of the Sun within its own larger period, one may experience unsteadiness, suffering caused by poison, theft, or "evil eye" <note>original: "Vishamekshanam," literally "uneven" or "harsh" looking.</note>. One should predict a difficult or painful death. || 21 ||

**Sun—Moon:** When the Moon enters the Breath Period of the Sun, there is happiness, an abundance of food, the performance of refined rituals <note>original: "Samskara," life-cycle rites.</note>, and royal splendor. This comes through noble and steady actions. || 22 ||

**Sun—Mars:** When Mars enters the Breath Period of the Sun, there is trouble from the government <note>original: "Bhupa," the King.</note>, loss of wealth through others' affairs, and great fear. One experiences a significant decline in status or health. || 23 ||

**Sun—Rahu:** When the <term>North Node</term><note>Rahu, the shadow planet of the dragon's head.</note> enters the Breath Period of the Sun, there is great suffering arising from food, the appearance of poison or snakebite, and distress caused by finances, fire, or the authorities. || 24 ||

**Sun—Jupiter:** When Jupiter <note>original: "Guru" or "Jiva"</note> enters the Breath Period of the Sun, there is an accumulation of wealth from various sciences, and success in one's endeavors through frequent travel <note>original: "Gatagatais," coming and going.</note>. However, there may be exhaustion or loss due to over-exertion of one's life force. || 25 ||

**Sun—Saturn:** When Saturn enters the Breath Period of the Sun, there is imprisonment, threat to life, mental agitation, many obstacles, and great losses. || 26 ||

**Sun—Mercury:** When Mercury enters the Breath Period of the Sun, one constantly enjoys food provided by the state, receives royal honors or titles <note>original: "Raja-lanchhana," royal insignia.</note>, and the inner self is truly satisfied. || 27 ||

**Sun—Ketu:** When the <term>South Node</term><note>Ketu, the shadow planet of the dragon's tail.</note> enters the Breath Period of the Sun, there is mutual conflict, loss of wealth, and defeat. One suffers the loss of teachers, women, or kinsmen. || 28 ||

**Sun—Venus:** When Venus enters the Breath Period of the Sun, one receives honor from the authorities, an increase in wealth, and happiness derived from one's wife and children. There is enjoyment of fine food and drink. || 29 ||

## Now, the Results of Jupiter’s Breath Period.

(Jupiter-Jupiter) The end of grief, an abundance of wealth, the performance of the fire sacrifice <note>original: "Agnihotram," a traditional Vedic ritual of maintaining the sacred fire</note>, and the worship of Lord Shiva. One also gains a vehicle equipped with a ceremonial umbrella <note>A symbol of high social status or royalty</note>. These are the results of Jupiter’s <note>original: "Jiva"</note> breath period. || 57 ||

(Jupiter-Saturn) The breaking of religious vows, a wandering nature <note>original: "Suryavartishcha," literally "turning like the sun," implying constant movement or lack of stability</note>, loss of wealth in foreign lands, conflict, and the destruction of riches occur when Saturn <note>original: "Shani"</note> is in the breath period of Jupiter. || 58 ||

(Jupiter-Ketu) Knowledge, the arrival of splendor and scholarship, listening to the sacred scriptures, and the worship of Lord Shiva. One also engages in fire sacrifices and shows devotion to their teacher when Ketu <note>original: "Dhvaje," meaning "the banner"</note> is in the breath period of Jupiter. || 59 ||

(Saturn-Ketu) The agonizing pain of death and trouble caused by ghosts or malevolent spirits. One may also be overpowered or disgraced by the wife of another when Ketu <note>original: "Dhvaje"</note> is in the breath period of Saturn. || 67 ||

(Saturn-Venus) Happiness through children, wealth, and splendor, as well as joy from land and honors. One performs fire sacrifices and may celebrate a marriage when Venus <note>original: "Bhrigau"</note> is in the breath period of Saturn. || 68 ||

(Saturn-Sun) Pain in the eyes, diseases of the head, and fear of snakes and enemies. There is loss of wealth and great distress when the Sun <note>original: "Ravau"</note> is in the breath period of Saturn...

## Now begins the section concerning the Kalachakra Dasha.
<note>The Kalachakra or "Time-Wheel" Dasha is considered by Parashara to be the most supreme system of planetary periods, specifically based on the movement of the Moon through the lunar mansions and their quarters.</note>

I bow to the Lord of the Gopis <note>Krishna</note>, to Goddess Saraswati <note>Bharati</note>, and to Ganesha <note>the Leader of the Ganas</note>. This Time-Wheel was narrated in ancient times to Goddess Parvati by Lord Shiva <note>original: "Pinakina," the wielder of the Pinaka bow</note>. || 1 ||

Having extracted the essence of that Wheel, it is described here by a simplified method. It reveals the auspicious and inauspicious fates of men—past, present, and future. || 2 ||

The numbers five <note>5</note>, twenty-one <note>21</note>, seven <note>7</note>, nine <note>9</note>, ten <note>10</note>, sixteen <note>16</note>, and four <note>4</note> are assigned to the Sun and the other planets respectively, based on the lords of the signs. || 3 ||
<note>These numbers represent the years assigned to each planet in the Kalachakra system: Sun (5), Moon (21), Mars (7), Mercury (9), Jupiter (10), Venus (16), and Saturn (4).</note>

Based on the specific division <note>original: "amshaka," referring to the 1/9th division of a sign</note> at the time of a person's birth or at the time of a query, one should calculate the lifespan and its events through the sequence of the nine divisions. || 4 ||

For the lunar mansions Ashwini, Punarvasu <note>Aditi</note>, Hasta, Mula, and Purva Bhadrapada <note>Prosthapada</note>, the count of the divisions begins from Aries and proceeds in a clockwise <note>original: "pradakshinya"</note> order. || 5 ||

O Parvati, for Rohini <note>Prajapatya</note>, Magha, Vishakha <note>Indragni</note>, and Shravana, these lunar mansions are reckoned in a counter-clockwise <note>original: "apradakshina"</note> order. || 6 ||

The three constellations starting with Ashwini are arranged on the Right Path <note>Savya - clockwise</note>; the three constellations starting with Rohini are arranged on the Left Path <note>Apasavya - counter-clockwise</note>. || 7 ||

In this manner, by dividing each constellation into four quarters, one should construct the Wheel. The lifespan <note>original: "ayurdaya"</note> of a person is determined based on the specific quarter in which they were born. || 8 ||

The lifespan is full if born at the start of a division, moderate if in the middle, and others declare it to be as painful as an untimely death <note>original: "apamrityu"</note> if born at the end of a division. || 9 ||

Having understood these clear principles, the wise person should calculate the signs and their divisions. Hereafter, I shall explain the method for this through proportional calculation. || 10 ||

### The Lords of the Periods

O Parvati, listen now to the nine lords of the periods <term>daśādhipās</term> as they have been determined. || 25 || For the five constellations <term>nakṣatras</term>—Bharani, Pushya, Chitra, Purvashadha, and Uttarabhadrapada—one should observe the sequence starting from the first quarter of Bharani. || 26 ||

**For the first quarter of Bharani:**
The Body <term>deha</term> is Scorpio and the Soul <term>jīva</term> is Pisces. <note>In the Kalachakra system, 'Body' and 'Soul' represent the start and end points of a specific life-cycle sequence.</note> The sequence of signs follows the order of Scorpio, Libra, Virgo, Cancer, Leo, Gemini, Taurus, Aries, and Pisces. <note>original: "nāgāgartupayo-dhīṣu rāmākṣīdrk-mekharāḥ" — these are coded numerical references to the zodiac signs 8, 7, 6, 4, 5, 3, 2, 1, and 12.</note> || 27 ||

**For the second quarter of Bharani:**
The Body is Aquarius and the Soul is Virgo. The signs are: Aquarius, Capricorn, Sagittarius, Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, and Virgo. <note>original: "rudradinnandacandrākṣirāmābdhīṣu raseśvarāḥ" refers to signs 11, 10, 9, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.</note> || 28 ||

**For the third quarter of Bharani:**
The Body is Libra and the Soul is Virgo. The signs are: Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces, Scorpio, Libra, and Virgo. || 29 ||

**For the fourth quarter of Bharani:**
The Body and Soul are remembered as Cancer and Sagittarius. The signs are: Cancer, Leo, Gemini, Taurus, Aries, Pisces, Aquarius, Capricorn, and Sagittarius. || 30 ||

->Thus should the direct <term>savya</term> order be understood; now the indirect <term>apasavya</term> order is described.<-

One should draw a wheel with twelve spokes, arranged equally horizontally and vertically. || 31 || In the second and subsequent houses, write the signs starting from Scorpio. For the group of four constellations—Rohini, Magha, Vishakha, and Shravana— || 32 || look to the Body and Soul as Cancer and Sagittarius. The lords are the signs: Cancer, Leo, Gemini, Taurus, Aries, Pisces, Aquarius, Capricorn, and Sagittarius. || 33 ||

**For the second quarter of Rohini:**
The Body and Soul are Libra and Virgo. The signs are: Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Pisces, Aquarius, Capricorn, Sagittarius, Scorpio, and Libra. || 34 ||

**For the third quarter of Rohini:**
The Body and Soul are the lords of Aquarius and Virgo. The sequence is: Virgo, Leo, Cancer, Gemini, Taurus, Aries, Sagittarius, Capricorn, and Aquarius. || 35 ||

**For the fourth quarter of Rohini:**
The Body and Soul are recorded as Scorpio and Pisces. The sequence of lords for the eight signs begins with Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, and Scorpio. <note>original: "sūryendudviguṇeṣvabdhi..."</note> || 36 ||

The eight constellations—Mrigashira, Ardra, Purvaphalguni, Uttaraphalguni, Anuradha, Jyeshtha, Dhanishta, and Shatabhisha—should be understood to follow the order of the Moon's constellation <term>cāndra</term>. || 37 ||

**For the first quarter of Mrigashira:**
The Body and Soul are Cancer and Pisces. The ten period lords go in reverse from Pisces back to Cancer. || 38 ||

**For the second quarter of the Moon's constellation:**
The Body is Taurus and the Soul is Gemini. The lords are the rulers of the signs: Gemini, Taurus, Aries, Pisces, Aquarius, Capricorn, Sagittarius, Scorpio, and Libra. || 39 ||

**For the third quarter of Mrigashira:**
The Body and Soul are Capricorn and Gemini. The rulers are the signs: Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Pisces, Aquarius, and Capricorn. || 40 ||

<meta>This page transitions from the general rules of the Kalachakra Dasha system—specifically the "reverse" or "indirect" (apasavya) order—into a practical mathematical demonstration. It uses the specific position of the Moon at birth to calculate how much of a planetary period has already passed and how much remains for the native's life.</meta>

<page-num>357</page-num>
<header>Chapter 49: The Fruits of the Kalachakra Dasha (First Half)</header>

In the reverse order, the signs are taken from Sagittarius to Aries, and the lords of these signs are the lords of the periods <term>daśādhipās</term>. || 41 || In this reverse manner, one should understand the "Body" <term>deha</term> and "Soul" <term>jīva</term> and their respective periods. All of this has been clearly explained to you, O Parvati, my beloved. || 42 ||

## Now, an illustration of the calculation for the Kalachakra Dasha:

The longitude of the Moon <term>spaṣṭacandra</term> is 1 sign, 8 degrees, 15 minutes, and 7 seconds. Converting this entire value into minutes <term>kalāpiṇḍa</term>, we get 2295 minutes and 7 seconds. By dividing this by 800 <note>The total minutes in one nakshatra or lunar mansion</note>, we find that 2 constellations have already passed (which we discard). The remainder is 695 minutes and 7 seconds.

Multiplying this by 60 and dividing by 800, we determine the time spent in the current constellation: 52 <term>ghatikās</term> <note>A unit of time equal to 24 minutes</note> and 8 <term>palas</term> <note>A unit of time equal to 24 seconds</note>. Thus, in the constellation of Krittika <note>The 3rd nakshatra</note>, the elapsed time is 52 ghatis and 8 palas. 

Because the elapsed time in the constellation exceeds 45 ghatis, we determine this falls into the fourth quarter <term>caraṇa</term> of Krittika. For this quarter, the Lord of the Body is the Moon and the Lord of the Soul is Jupiter. This leads to the Pisces-influenced period <term>mīnāṃśadaśā</term>, which has a total duration of 86 years. 

To find the portion of the 86 years already "consumed" in a previous state:
We take the remainder and multiply it by the total period years (86). Dividing by the standard units (900), we calculate: 40 years, 10 months, 23 days, and 12 ghatis. This is the "elapsed" time <term>bhuktavarṣādi</term>.

By subtracting this from the total period of 86 years, we find the "remaining" time to be experienced in this life <term>bhogyavarṣādi</term>:
**45 years, 1 month, 6 days, 40 ghatis, and 0 palas.**
<note>The manuscript lists 45 | 1 | 6 | 40 | 0 as the remaining time for the native to experience this specific planetary cycle.</note>

This method of calculation should be applied in all cases. The birth occurred during the Venus sub-period within the larger Pisces period: 10 | 1 | 6 | 48 | 0.

<header>The Essence of the Great Parashara Horoscopy</header>

# Next, the results of the Wheel of Time are described.

In the division of **Aries**, one should be known as a rogue. In the division of **Taurus** (ruled by Venus), one becomes knowledgeable and successful. In the division of **Gemini** (ruled by Mercury), one is wise and prosperous. In the division of **Cancer**, one becomes a king. || 41 ||

In the division of **Leo**, one is said to be of a royal or passionate nature. In the division of **Virgo** (ruled by Mercury), one becomes a scholar. In the division of **Libra**, one becomes a minister to a king. In the division of **Scorpio** (ruled by Mars), one becomes poor. || 42 ||

In the division of **Sagittarius**, one is endowed with wisdom. In the division of **Capricorn**, one is a performer of sinful deeds. In the division of **Aquarius**, one follows the profession of a merchant. In the division of **Pisces**, one is indeed wealthy in grain. || 43 ||

# Next, the results of the Rising Planet are described.

With the rising of the **Sun**, one attains a kingdom. With the rising of the **Moon**, one finds success in agriculture. With the rising of **Mars**, one becomes a brave warrior, though prone to engaging in sinful acts. || 44 ||

With the rising of **Mercury**, one possesses a pure intellect and becomes an eminent scholar. With the rising of **Jupiter** or **Venus**, one attains a kingdom. With the rising of **Saturn**, one becomes a rogue or a thief. || 45 ||

# Next, the results of the "Body" and "Life-force" points are described.

<note>In the Kalachakra system, the "Body" (Deha) and "Life-force" (Jiva) are two sensitive zodiac signs calculated based on the birth star. Their health determines the individual's longevity and well-being during specific time cycles.</note>

When the "Body" and "Life-force" signs are joined by planets such as **Mars**, the **Sun**, and others, even a single such combination indicates death; what then can be said if many such planets are present? || 46 ||

In whatever place the "Life-force" and "Body" signs are joined together, if they are further combined with malefic <note>harmful</note> planets, one should predict death during that specific time-period (*dasha*). || 47 ||

When the "Body" sign is afflicted, there is great suffering; when the "Life-force" sign is afflicted, it brings death. If both are afflicted by planetary conjunctions, the individual is destroyed; of this, there is no doubt. || 48 ||

When the "Life-force" point is occupied by the **Life-force** planet <note>the ruler of the Jiva sign</note> along with **Rahu** <note>the North Node of the Moon</note>, **Saturn**, a **retrograde** planet, or the **Sun**, one should recognize the timing of death and perform the prescribed peace rituals (*shanti*) according to the traditional rules. || 49 ||

When the "Life-force" point is occupied by the **Moon**, **Mercury**, **Jupiter**, or **Venus**, these planets bring happiness and the destruction of disease and the threat of death. || 50 ||

When the time-period of a malefic sign occurs, the "Body" and "Life-force" points become distressed. When the time-period of a benefic <note>auspicious</note> sign occurs, and is joined by benefic planets, auspicious results follow. || 51 ||

When the "Body" point is joined by benefic planets, the attainment of ornaments and wealth is certain. When the "Life-force" point is joined by benefic planets, one obtains sons, a wife, and similar blessings. || 52 ||

<header>Chapter 49: Describing the Results of the Wheel of Time Periods in the First Section</header>

# Now, the section on the Movements of Planets.

The first type of movement is called the **Frog-leap** <note>original: "manduki"; a jump that skips one sign</note>; the second is the **Monkey-leap** <note>original: "markati"; a backward jump between signs</note>. The movement extending as far as the fifth sign is known as the **Lion’s Gaze** <note>original: "simhavalokana"; a leap across several signs, named after the way a lion looks back over its shoulder while walking</note>. || 53 ||

# Now, the results are stated.

In the **Frog-leap**, there is great disease; in the **Monkey-leap**, there is great fear; and in the **Lion’s Gaze**, death occurs—this is according to the words of the sage Garga. || 54 ||

# Describing the results of the "Lion's Gaze" and "Frog-leap" movements.

A leap from **Virgo** to **Cancer**, or from **Leo** to **Gemini**, is known as the **Frog-leap** movement. It indeed causes such diseases as mentioned. || 55 || A leap from **Pisces** to **Scorpio**, or from **Sagittarius** up to **Aries**, is called the **Lion’s Gaze** movement; one obtains results accordingly. || 56 ||

If a **Frog-leap** occurs within the path of a **Lion’s Gaze**, it causes accidental death; in such a case, the person grieves and should perform penance. || 57 || When the movement goes from **Pisces** to **Scorpio**, fever certainly occurs. When it goes from **Virgo** to **Cancer**, it causes the destruction of the mother and relatives. || 58 ||

When moving from **Leo** to **Gemini**, disease surely happens to the wife. When the movement goes to **Cancer** while the Sun is positioned there, it brings death to living beings. Further, one should know that moving from **Sagittarius** to **Aries** brings the death of the father and relatives. || 59 ||

# The results of movements are stated again.

When moving from **Virgo** to **Cancer**, there is great benefit in the eastern region. || 60 || If one takes refuge in the northern country, the journey will be a happy one. When moving from **Leo** to **Gemini**, the eastern region should be avoided. Even if work remains unfinished, a journey toward the southwest will be happy. || 61 ||

In **Cancer**, **Aries**, and **Leo**, there is a loss of work when combined with certain planetary alignments. By taking refuge in the southern direction, there will be travel every year. || 62 || In **Aquarius**, there is disease and mental grief; in **Gemini**, one becomes poor. When moving from **Pisces** to **Scorpio**, danger comes while traveling north. In **Capricorn**, there is danger and sorrow, and danger is also spoken of for **Sagittarius**. || 63 || In **Sagittarius** and **Aries**, there is fear during travel, as well as the risk of slaughter or imprisonment...

...death occurs. In **Libra**, one gains wealth and marriage; in **Scorpio**, one obtains a wife and movement. || 64 || In **Aries**, know the result of Venus to be happiness and travel to the south. If **Saturn** is positioned at the conjunction of the **Body** and **Soul** <note>original: "deha-jiva-samayoga"; these are two critical points in the Kalachakra calculation—if a malefic planet sits at their meeting point, it is considered highly dangerous</note>, he causes accidental or untimely death. || 65 || (Thus, having understood the results of the signs, one should calculate the Major and Sub-periods according to the sequence of the constellations and the Body and Soul points, following the clockwise path starting from Scorpio.)

### Now, the results of the Major Periods are stated.

The results of the **Sun** <note>implied by context of "Arka"</note> include diseases caused by an excess of bile and blood. The **Moon** <note>original: "shashi"</note> bestows an increase in wealth, fame, and children, as well as clothing and ornaments. || 66 || **Mars** <note>original: "kuja"</note> quickly indicates fever, bilious complaints, and skin eruptions or swellings. In the period of **Mercury** <note>original: "budha"</note>, there is an increase in children, wealth, intelligence, and the enjoyment of life's pleasures. || 67 || **Jupiter** <note>original: "brihaspati"</note> brings wealth, fame, the growth of the family, and various types of enjoyment. The results of **Venus** <note>original: "bhrigu"</note> are education, marriage, fertile lands, houses, and an abundance of grain. || 68 || The results of **Saturn** <note>original: "shani"</note> are excessive internal heat, great sorrow, and the loss of relatives. Thus, the results are determined by the combination of the Sun and other planets with the specific zodiac signs. || 69 ||

Predict auspicious results from favorable combinations and inauspicious results from unfavorable ones. For mixed combinations, predict a mixture of results arising from the specific signs and planets. || 70 || A judgment should be made based on the periods of the twelfth, eighth, or the birth sign <note>these are traditionally considered difficult houses in astrology</note>. Realizing that a time of death is approaching, the wise person should perform **peace-making rituals** <note>original: "shanti"; religious rites or offerings intended to mitigate negative planetary influences</note>. || 71 ||

### Now, the determination of longevity based on the Ninth-parts is stated.

The remaining units of time are multiplied by the life-span factor of fifteen—this is the sequence of the **Wheel of Time** <note>original: "Kalachakra"</note> method for determining the span of life. Multiply by the specific years and divide accordingly. || 72-73 || Based on the specific **Ninth-part** <note>term: "navamsha"; a 3°20' subdivision of a zodiac sign used for fine-tuned predictions</note> where the Moon is positioned: death will occur at the end of the nine Ninth-part signs counted from that position. || 74 ||

### Now, the results of the Sub-periods are stated.

Whichever planet aspects the Ascendant, or whichever planet it is joined with, or whichever sign the planet is stationed in—the person will experience results corresponding to those factors. || 75 || Now, O Goddess of the Gods, I shall speak of the divisions...

# First Section: Chapter 49 on Telling the Results of the Wheel of Time Periods.

->The results of those periods.<-

I shall now describe the results of these periods according to the traditional rules; listen, O Lotus-faced one! || 76 ||

In the first sub-division, **Mars** <note>original: "Bhauma"</note> causes death, fever, and the eruption of wounds. If **Mercury**, **Venus**, the **Moon**, or **Jupiter** <note>original: "Budha-Shukra-Indu-Jiveshu"</note> are present, one should predict the gain of clothing and ornaments. || 77 || O Goddess, worshipped by the gods! One certainly gains these when a planet is in its **own sub-division** <term>Svamsha: a specific mathematical portion of a zodiac sign that "belongs" to that planet in this system</term>. In the sub-division of **Saturn** <note>original: "Sauri"</note>, there is great fear, agitation from enemies, and conflict with the King. || 78 ||

### Results for the Sub-division of Aries
When the **Sun** <note>original: "Aditya"</note> is placed in the sub-division of **Aries** <note>original: "Mesha"</note>, the following sequence of results is determined: If **Jupiter** <note>original: "Guru"</note> is in the Aries sub-division, the person attains the favor of the King. || 79 ||

### Results for the Sub-division of Taurus
O Goddess, if **Jupiter** is positioned in the sub-division of **Taurus** <note>original: "Vrishabha"</note>, the result is the gain of knowledge, great affection, and physical comfort. || 80 || O Goddess, if **Mars** <note>original: "Kuja"</note> enters the sub-division of **Taurus**, the result is exile from one's country, death, fever, or wounds from weapons. || 81 || The result of **Venus**, the **Moon**, or **Mercury** <note>original: "Shukra-Indu-Suta-Chandranam"</note> being in their own sub-divisions within **Taurus** is the gain of clothing and ornaments, and a significant union with a woman. || 82 || The **Sun** <note>original: "Ravi"</note> in the sub-division of **Taurus** brings fear from the King, the death of the father, great fear from wild animals <note>original: "mrigadyaih," literally "deer and others," implying forest hazards</note>, and minor illnesses. || 83 ||

### Results for the Sub-division of Gemini
O Goddess, when **Venus** <note>original: "Bhrigu"</note> is in the sub-division of **Gemini** <note>original: "Mithuna"</note>, one obtains pearls, ornaments, a wife, and fine clothing. || 84 || **Mars** <note>original: "Kuja"</note> in the sub-division of **Gemini** causes fear regarding the mother or father, fever, the appearance of wounds, and compels one to go on a journey. || 85 || If **Jupiter** <note>original: "Guru"</note> is in the sub-division of **Gemini**, the person gains knowledge, wealth, great prosperity, and receives universal affection. || 86 || O Goddess, if **Saturn** <note>original: "Shani"</note> is in the sub-division of **Gemini**, there will be travel, great disease, death, loss of wealth, and the loss of kinsmen. || 87 || If **Mercury** <note>original: "Budha"</note> is in the sub-division of **Gemini**, one gains clothing, children, and knowledge, and attains universal affection. || 88 ||

### Results for the Sub-division of Cancer
The **Moon** <note>original: "Shashi"</note> in the sub-division of **Cancer** <note>original: "Kulira," the crab</note> brings sovereignty, the gain of wealth, reunion with wife and children, and peace of mind. || 89 || The **Sun** <note>original: "Ravi"</note> in the sub-division of **Cancer** brings fear from the King, fear from enemies, and great danger from wild animals, as well as fever, disease, and burning sensations. || 90 || O Goddess, in the conjunction of **Mercury and Venus** in the sub-division of **Cancer**, one gains children, kinsmen, gems, knowledge, and wealth. || 91 || **Mars** <note>original: "Kuja"</note> in the sub-division of **Cancer** brings a terrible death by poison or weapons, or death arising from fever and burning heat; one experiences every kind of sorrow. || 92 || One attains a great increase in prosperity, the gain of wealth, and the favor of the King when **Jupiter** [is in...] <note>The sentence continues onto the next page.</note>

### Summary of the Great Parashara Astrology

...[if] **Jupiter** <note>original: "Guru"</note> is in the sub-division of Cancer || 93 ||

When **Saturn** <note>original: "Shani"</note> is in the sub-division of **Cancer** <note>original: "Kulira"</note>, the person suffers from wind-related diseases <term>Vata-vyadhi: according to Ayurvedic medicine, ailments related to the air humor, often involving joints or the nervous system</term>, sudden strikes, smallpox <note>original: "Masura"</note>, bites from poisonous creatures, and experiences all kinds of distress. || 94 ||

O Goddess! When **Venus** <note>original: "Bhargava"</note> or **Mercury** <note>original: "Budha"</note> arrive in the sub-division of **Leo**, the person gains clothing, jewelry, knowledge, and the blessing of children and a spouse. || 96 ||

Fear of great enemies, fever, and disease—as well as ignorance and even the death of a king—occur when a planet is in the sub-division of **Leo**. || 98 ||

Great gains of wealth and grain, the favor of priests <term>Dvija: literally "twice-born," referring to the learned priestly class</term> and gods, and the attainment of knowledge happen when **Jupiter** <note>original: "Guru"</note> is in the sub-division of **Leo**. || 99 ||

The favor of the king, profit, prosperity, and the gathering of relatives, as well as the gain of knowledge, occur when **Jupiter** is in the sub-division of **Virgo**. || 101 ||

Journeying, fever, fear of smallpox <note>original: "Masuri"</note> and fire, wounds from weapons, and death occur when **Mars** is in the sub-division of **Virgo**. || 2 || <note>The verse numbering in the original manuscript resets or simplifies here</note>

Gaining servants, children, and wealth, as well as clothing and jewelry, is the result for **Venus**, **Mercury** <note>original: "Indusuta," literally "Son of the Moon"</note>, and the **Moon** <note>original: "Chandra"</note> when in the sub-division of **Virgo**. || 3 ||

Travel, fever, the loss of children, and death by the strike of a weapon occur when the **Sun** <note>original: "Ravi"</note> is in the sub-division of **Virgo**. || 4 ||

[Gain from] the father and friends, but also head-diseases, fever, and wounds from weapons or fire happen when **Mars** is in the sub-division of **Libra**. || 6 ||

Wealth, gems, great profits, the practice of religion, activities that please the king, and the abundance of all forms of prosperity occur when **Jupiter** is in the sub-division of **Libra**. || 7 ||

## Section One: Chapter 49 on the Results of the Wheel of Time System <note>original: "Kalachakra-dasha-phala-adhyaya"</note>

Agitation from enemies, fear, disease, loss of wealth, and fear concerning the father—these occur when the **Sun** <note>original: "Ravi"</note> is in its own sub-division in **Scorpio** <note>original: "Vrishchika"</note>. || 11 ||

Worshipping gods, performing penance and meditation, and the opportunity to honor Brahmins are the results for **Venus** <note>original: "Bhargava"</note>, **Mercury** <note>original: "Gna"</note>, and **Jupiter** <note>original: "Jiva"</note> when in the sub-division of **Capricorn**. || 20 ||

Diseases of the head, fever, injuries to the hands and feet, blood-bile disorders <term>Raktapitta: a condition in Ayurveda where blood is corrupted by bile, leading to internal or external bleeding</term>, and diarrhea occur when **Mars** <note>original: "Kuja"</note> is in its own sub-division in **Capricorn**. || 21 ||

Gain of various branches of knowledge and wealth; the birth of sons and the company of a wife and friends; prosperity and financial success occur when **Venus** <note>original: "Bhrigu"</note> is in its own sub-division in **Aquarius** <note>original: "Ghata," literally "the Water-Pot"</note>. || 23 ||

Fever, injuries from fire or thieves, and great fear from enemies; the person suffers mental grief when **Mars** <note>original: "Kuja"</note> is in its own sub-division in **Aquarius**. || 24 ||

Aggravation of the three humors <term>Tridosha: the three biological energies—Vata, Pitta, and Kapha—which, when imbalanced, cause disease</term>, quarreling, and aimless wandering through the country; one suffers from wasting disease <note>original: "Kshaya-vyadhi," often referring to tuberculosis or general decay</note> when **Saturn** <note>original: "Shani"</note> is in its own sub-division in **Aquarius**. || 26 ||

Gain of children, friends, wealth, and a wife; things that are pleasing to the mind; good fortune and the gain of fine clothing occur when **Mercury** <note>original: "Budha"</note> is in its own sub-division in **Aquarius**. || 27 ||

In **Aries** <note>original: "Mesha"</note>, there is distress concerning gems; in **Taurus** <note>original: "Vrishabha"</note>, an increase in grain; and in **Gemini** <note>original: "Mithuna"</note>, a wealth of knowledge. Gain of wealth occurs in **Sagittarius** <note>original: "Chapa"</note> within the cycle of Aries. In **Capricorn** <note>original: "Makara"</note>, one engages in sinful deeds, and in **Aquarius** <note>original: "Kumbha"</note>, commerce. || 39 ||

In **Gemini** <term>Mithuna</term>, all goals are accomplished; in **Cancer** <term>Karkata</term>, total success is granted. In **Leo** <term>Simha</term>, there is prosperity as before; in **Virgo** <term>Kanya</term>, a quarrel occurs. || 55 ||

There is an increase in sons in **Sagittarius**. || 56 ||
In **Capricorn** <term>Makara</term>, a son is gained; in **Aquarius** <term>Kumbha</term>, there is an increase in grain. In **Pisces** <term>Meena</term>, one attains well-being; in **Scorpio** <term>Vrishchika</term>, there is trouble from wild animals. || 57 ||
In **Libra** <term>Taulika</term>, wealth is gained; in **Virgo** <term>Kanya</term>, enemies increase.

In **Cancer** <note>original: "Shashibha"</note>, one attains fortune; in **Leo** <term>Simha</term>, trouble from wild animals. || 58 ||

# Now, the results of the Chara Dasha are stated.

Now I shall explain the results of the **Moving Period** <term>Chara Paryaya Dasha</term>. By merely knowing this, O Twice-born <note>original: "dvija," referring to the Brahmin student to whom this knowledge is addressed</note>, one becomes a true astrologer. || 1 ||

One becomes a knower of all things—lifespan, happiness, sorrow, and both auspicious and inauspicious events for all people—without any doubt; of this, there is no question. || 2 ||

Starting from the **birth ascendant** <term>janma-lagna</term> up to the **twelfth house** <note>original: "bhānu-bhāva," the house associated with the Sun or the 12th house in sequence</note>, O best of the twice-born, these are known to grant years of life. I shall now speak of their results. || 3 ||

When the sign that provides the period is in the eighth <term>randhra</term> or in a trine <term>trikona: the 1st, 5th, or 9th positions</term> from its original place and is joined by a malefic planet, O Brahmin, that period brings sorrow. || 4 ||

If **malefics** <term>papa</term> are located in the third or sixth houses, victory and success are proclaimed. However, if a **benefic planet** <term>shubha-kheta</term> is joined there, even then, defeat may occur <note>This suggests that benefics in 'upachaya' or growth houses (3rd/6th) can sometimes weaken the aggressive drive needed for victory</note>. || 5 ||

If both benefics and malefics are in the **house of gain** <term>labha-stha: the 11th house</term>, gain is certainly achieved. When the sign providing the period is joined by a benefic planet, O Brahmin... || 6 ||

...and that sign is in the house of a benefic, the period's results will be auspicious. If joined by a malefic but in a house owned by a benefic, the first part of the period brings great happiness. || 7 ||

If the period is of a malefic's house but joined by a benefic, happiness is experienced first. If it is a malefic's house joined by a malefic, that period grants total sorrow. || 8 ||

During the period of a benefic's house at night, joined by both malefic and benefic planets, O Brahmin... || 9 ||

...hardship comes first, and happiness follows later without a doubt. In a malefic's house with both malefic and benefic planets, happiness comes first, followed by a neutral state. In a benefic's house, auspicious results are predicted; in a malefic's house, the results are inauspicious. || 10 ||

In the second or fifth houses, benefics... <note>The text breaks off here at the end of the page</note>

# Chapter 50: Results of the Moving Period (Chara Dasha) in the First Section

->...surely gains the favor of the king and victory. When a malefic planet <note>original: "pape," referring to "cruel" planets like Saturn or Mars</note> is in the third house from the sign of the period, there is the subduing of enemies and victory. || 11 ||<-

In the fourth house, a benefic planet brings auspicious happiness; in the eighth house, it brings health. In the ninth house, a benefic increases righteousness <term>Dharma: religious and moral duty</term> and brings happiness through one’s elders or teachers. || 12 ||

In the opposite case <note>i.e., when a malefic planet occupies these houses</note>, the results are reversed; with mixed planets, mixed results are declared. If a malefic is in the house of enjoyment <note>the bhoga-sthana</note>, physical pain and mental distress are caused by that malefic. || 13 ||

If there are two malefic associations in the seventh house, or a malefic is present there, suffering for the wife is declared. In the fourth house, there is loss of position; in the fifth, there is suffering related to one's children. || 14 ||

In the tenth house, there is a loss of fame; in the ninth, suffering for the father. When a malefic is in a sign ruled by a malefic, all kinds of obstacles and pains occur without relief. || 15 ||

If a benefic planet <note>original: "saumye," literally "gentle" or "lunar" planets like Jupiter or Venus</note> is in the aforementioned houses, then one should predict happiness. A benefic located in a cardinal house <note>the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses, known as Kendras</note> bestows gains and victory over enemies. || 16 ||

The results of the periods of various signs <term>Rashi: a zodiac sign</term> should be declared by considering the positions of planets at the time of birth as well as their current transits <note>original: "agochara," referring to the movement of planets across the sky</note>. || 17 ||

A sign that is occupied by benefics, or is preceded by benefic planets, is said to give auspicious results during its period; the opposite is true for the reverse. || 18 ||

One should state the good or bad results based on whether benefics or malefics are located in the trines <note>the 1st, 5th, and 9th houses</note>, the eighth, or the twelfth houses; otherwise, the results for those sign periods will vary. || 19 ||

For the signs of Aries, Capricorn, Libra, and Cancer respectively, the **obstruction houses** <term>Badhasthana: houses that can block progress</term> are declared to be Aquarius, Taurus, Leo, and Scorpio. || 20 ||

If the period-lord is in a movable sign, or in a highly benefic **obstruction house** <term>Badhasthana</term>, there is great sorrow, imprisonment, and the destruction of wealth. || 21 ||

If a planet is exalted or in its own sign there, it brings auspiciousness, happiness, and the arrival of wealth. If that house is vacant, there is unhappiness and the period will not be fruitful. || 22 ||

If Rahu <note>the North Node of the Moon</note> is in the obstructing, twelfth, sixth, or eighth houses, there is great fear, displacement, imprisonment, harassment from the king, and fear of enemies. || 23 ||

If the Sun, Mars, Rahu, or Saturn are located in the sign of the **sub-period** <term>Bhukti</term>, there is a downfall and great fear due to the king's anger. || 24 ||

If a debilitated planet is in the trine of the **sub-period** <term>Bhukti</term> sign, or if a debilitated or malefic planet is joined with that sign, one should predict the fear of death. || 25 ||

When a person reaches a **sub-period** <term>Bhukti-dasha</term> where a planet is in its sign of highest exaltation, or in a trine that is an exaltation sign, then that man obtains happiness. || 26 ||

He gains lordship over cities and villages, the birth of a son, the arrival of wealth, auspicious earthly fortune, and a very high military command.

# Summary of the Great Parashara Compendium on Horoscopy

|| 27 || If the **Lord of the Period** <note>original: "pakeshwara," the planet ruling the specific time-cycle</note> is aspected by **Jupiter** <note>original: "jiva"</note> and is situated in an auspicious sign, then during that period, there will be the acquisition of wealth and auspicious events approved by one's children. || 28 ||

The **Enemy Signs** <term>Ripurasayah: zodiac signs that are naturally hostile to a specific planet, weakening its effects</term> for the **Sun** are those ruled by Venus and Saturn <note>Taurus, Libra, Capricorn, and Aquarius</note>. For **Mars**, the enemy signs are Scorpio, Libra, and Aquarius. || 29 ||

For **Mercury**, the enemy signs are Aquarius, Pisces, Gemini <note>this is unusual as Gemini is its own sign; the text likely refers to specific degrees or complex relationships</note>, Libra, and Virgo. Furthermore, Cancer, Pisces, Scorpio, and Aquarius are also considered like enemies for certain planets. || 30 ||

**Aries, Leo, Sagittarius, Scorpio, and Cancer** are the enemies of **Saturn**. Other enemies are Taurus, Libra, Gemini, and Virgo. || 31 ||

**Leo, Scorpio, Cancer, and Sagittarius** are the enemy signs of **Venus**. In this manner, the wise priest should contemplate the sub-periods <note>original: "antardasha"</note> of the planets. || 32 ||

The planets that bestow **Royal Success** <term>Raja Yoga: combinations that lead to high status, power, or authority</term>, those situated between benefics, or those in the fourth house from the starting sign, produce auspicious or inauspicious results accordingly. || 33 ||

In such a period, one should predict happiness and the possibility of achieving "Royal Yoga." Even a **malefic planet** <note>original: "papopi," a naturally harsh planet like Mars or Saturn</note>, if placed between two benefics, will yield auspicious results. || 34 ||

In the midst of a generally inauspicious period, the sub-period of a **gentle planet** <note>original: "saumyasya," referring to benefics like the Moon, Mercury, Jupiter, or Venus</note> is beautiful. The period of a planet ruling a **trine** <note>the 1st, 5th, or 9th houses</note> also bestows auspiciousness. || 35 ||

If the beginning and end of a period occur in signs that are friendly or auspicious, the result is good. The learned person should calculate the auspiciousness for each sign as the period progresses. || 36 ||

If a benefic is in a trine from the starting sign, it brings auspiciousness. A period starting in an auspicious sign is considered very beautiful. || 37 ||

If a malefic is in an auspicious sign at the start of a period, the beginning may still be good. What more is there to say? The beginning of such a period will be favorable. || 38 ||

From the beginning to the end of a period involving **debilitated planets** <term>Nicha: the state where a planet is at its weakest and most troubled</term>, there is a reversal of one's fortune. || 39 ||

Wherever a debilitated planet is located, or if the sign is a trine, and the **Lord of the Sign** <note>original: "rashishvara"</note> is also debilitated or connected to other debilitated planets, it surely causes the reversal of fortune, O best of the twice-born. || 40-41 ||

For **Rahu and Ketu** <note>the north and south nodes of the Moon</note>, the groups of four signs starting from Aquarius and Scorpio are important. If the period begins in Aquarius, it will be auspicious. || 42 ||

If a period is predicted to be auspicious but the planet is situated in **Capricorn**, or if the sign at the end of the period is aspected by or joined with **Venus**, there may be a loss of wealth due to the **anger of the king** <note>original: "rajakopa," modernly interpreted as legal or governmental trouble</note>. || 43-44 ||

However, O best of the twice-born, this specific result <note>the loss of wealth</note> should not be feared during the period of **Saturn**, nor when the period-giver is in the sign of **Capricorn**. || 45 ||

At the end of **Rahu's** period <note>original: "Raho-dasha," the cycle of the North Node of the Moon</note>, there is the destruction of everything, including death or imprisonment. || 46 ||

Alternatively, the person may face exile from their country or endure great physical and mental suffering. If at the start of a period, the sub-period <note>original: "antara"</note> or a horse <note>original: "ashwa"</note> is associated with the second house, this is the result to be expected. || 52 ||

In this way, for the purpose of understanding the effects of the **Intervention** <term>Argala: a planetary alignment that "locks" or "unlocks" the influence of another planet</term>, Lord Brahma has demonstrated these rules. Whether a planet is malefic or auspicious, if it stays in a favorable Intervention... || 53 ||

...then the **Ascendant** <term>Lagna: the sign rising on the eastern horizon at birth</term> aspected or seen by it is prepared for great strength. If a planet is seen there in a **Reverse Intervention** <term>Viparita-Argala: an opposing influence that can neutralize an Intervention</term> position... || 54 ||

...even then, if it is situated such that it aspects the Ascendant, the result of the reverse position will manifest. Even in that aspected state, O best of the Twice-born <note>original: "dwijottama," a title for a Brahmin</note>, one should speak of auspiciousness without any doubt. || 55 ||

### Now, the Vehicles of the Planetary Periods

Now I shall properly describe the "Vehicles" of the periods. I speak this before you for the benefit of all living beings. || 1 ||

The **Donkey**, the **Horse**, the **Elephant**, the **Buffalo**, the **Jackal**, the **Lion**, the **Crow**, the **Swan**, and the **Peacock**—these are the nine vehicles for humans. || 2 ||

Count from one’s own **Birth Star** <term>Nakshatra: the lunar mansion the moon was in at birth</term> to the star occupied by the Moon at the start of a new period. Divide that number by nine. The remainder indicates the "Vehicle of the Moon" for that period. || 3 ||

If the **Donkey** <note>original: "khara"</note> is the vehicle at the start of a period, the person becomes a consumer of misery and is filled with dullness. They will be devoid of shame, lacking in wealth and grain, and may even find themselves without proper clothing. || 4 ||

The **Horse** vehicle <note>inferred from the following description</note> makes one restless and fickle, a great consumer of food, with a manifest intellect, and a commander of a sounding army. With a firm body...
